插件审批智能体筛选器
交付界面静默回复策略

text: Applies to everyone on this Gateway without restarting it.
translated: 适用于此 Gateway 上的所有人，无需重启。

text: To make changes, update the configuration file or deployment settings for this Gateway.
translated: 如需修改，请更新此 Gateway 的配置文件或部署设置。

text: Sign in on the computer that runs this claw.
translated: 请在运行此 claw 的计算机上登录。

text: Peer conversation type: "direct", "group", "channel", or legacy "dm" (deprecated alias for direct). Prefer "direct" for new configs and keep kind aligned with channel semantics.
translated: 会话对象的对话类型："direct"、"group"、"channel" 或旧版 "dm"（direct 的已弃用别名）。新配置请优先使用 "direct"，并确保 kind 与频道语义一致。

text: Optional per-agent embedded OpenClaw overrides. Use this to opt specific agents into stricter GPT-5 execution behavior without changing the global default.
translated: 可选的智能体级内嵌 OpenClaw 覆盖设置。使用此设置可为特定智能体启用更严格的 GPT-5 执行行为，而不更改全局默认设置。

text: OpenClaw saves a safety snapshot first.
translated: OpenClaw 会先保存一份安全快照。

text: Optional thread/topic target for channels that support threaded delivery of forwarded plugin approvals.
translated: 可选的会话串或话题目标，适用于支持将转发的插件审批投递到会话串的渠道。

text: The operation was approved for this request only.
translated: 此操作已获批准，仅对本次请求有效。

text: Extra headers merged into provider requests after default attribution and auth resolution.
translated: 在默认归属信息和身份验证解析完成后合并到提供商请求中的额外标头。
请重新连接以配置搜索。

text: Access to other people's sessions: "none" hides them even with explicit session membership, "view" allows reading, "suggest" permits the suggestion flow, and "write" permits participation without membership. Explicit session membership can raise "view" or "suggest" access for a specific session. Session creators and connections holding operator.admin retain their session access.
translated: 对他人会话的访问权限："none" 会隐藏这些会话，即使已被明确授予会话成员资格；"view" 允许读取；"suggest" 允许使用建议流程；"write" 允许在没有成员资格的情况下参与。明确的会话成员资格可以提升特定会话的 "view" 或 "suggest" 访问权限。会话创建者和具有 operator.admin 权限的连接会保留其会话访问权限。

text: Choose which matching video attachments are processed. Use first-only handling unless multi-video analysis is intentional.
translated: 选择要处理的匹配视频附件。除非明确需要分析多个视频，否则请仅处理第一个。

text: This removes the draft and any saved messages or attachments shown with it from this browser. It cannot be undone. Messages already sent to a session won’t be deleted.
translated: 这将从此浏览器中移除草稿，以及与其一同显示的所有已保存消息或附件。此操作无法撤销。已发送到会话的消息不会被删除。

text: Control UI discovery for external CLI session engines exposed by the Gateway session catalog. Enabled by default; disable to prevent starting those engines from the new-session model picker.
translated: 允许 Control UI 发现 Gateway 会话目录公开的外部 CLI 会话引擎。默认启用；禁用后，将无法从新建会话的模型选择器启动这些引擎。
首选辅助模型（提供商/模型或别名）。

text: Force this task to use the gateway default agent.
translated: 强制此任务使用 Gateway 默认智能体。

text: The {source} event source is managed by its plugin. Its schedule is preserved when saving.
translated: {source} 事件源由其插件管理。保存时会保留其调度设置。

text: Open {name} on the computer running OpenClaw and check its sign-in, then check again.
translated: 请在运行 OpenClaw 的计算机上打开 {name} 并检查其登录状态，然后重新检测。

text: This ClawHub link is invalid. Check the link and try again.
translated: 此 ClawHub 链接无效。请检查链接后重试。

text: The credential could not be saved. Your draft is still available; try saving again.
translated: 无法保存凭据。您的草稿仍然保留，请尝试再次保存。

text: Trigger words have not been saved. Your edits are retained. Reconnect to this Gateway, then retry.
translated: 唤醒词尚未保存。您的编辑已保留。请重新连接到此 Gateway 后重试。

text: Couldn’t load session history. Try again.
translated: 无法加载会话历史记录。请重试。

text: Waiting for your camera. Allow access if prompted.
translated: 正在等待摄像头就绪。如有提示，请允许访问。

text: This lets the sender talk to the agent in direct messages. It does not grant group access.
translated: 这将允许发送者通过私信与智能体交谈，但不会授予群组访问权限。
正在启动本地模型设置…

text: Inactive transcripts move into compressed JSONL files. Active sessions stay in the database; archived history is restored before use.
translated: 非活跃会话记录会移至压缩的 JSONL 文件中。活跃会话保留在数据库中；已归档的历史记录会在使用前恢复。

text: Review the current package before publishing.
translated: 发布前请审查当前软件包。

text: Maximum rounds per inbound message, including the initial round (integer: 1–4, default: 1). Follow-up rounds share bounded, attributed sibling replies and stop when every participant passes.
translated: 每条传入消息的最大轮数，包含初始轮次（整数：1–4，默认值：1）。后续轮次会共享有数量限制且注明来源的同组参与者回复，并在所有参与者均跳过时停止。

text: Groups exec-approval forwarding behavior including enablement, routing mode, filters, and explicit targets. Configure here when approval prompts must reach operational channels instead of only the origin thread.
translated: 集中管理 exec 审批转发行为，包括启用状态、路由模式、筛选器和指定目标。当审批提示需要发送到运维频道，而非仅发送到原始会话线程时，请在此配置。
链接理解的最大链接数

text: Override database.engine for this family. Changing an engine requires database port --family and a restart; editing config does not migrate existing data. Mixed-engine backup/restore preserves each store's engine, and updates require candidate family support.
translated: 为此数据族覆盖 database.engine。更改引擎需要运行 database port --family 并重启；编辑配置不会迁移现有数据。混合引擎备份/恢复会保留各存储的引擎，且更新要求候选版本支持相应数据族。

text: Usage grouped by who started each session, not by who sent each message.
translated: 用量按各会话的发起者分组，而非按各条消息的发送者分组。
Gateway 服务器设置 (端口、身份验证、绑定)
重新连接桌面以启用音频

text: OpenClaw activity identifies this Mac without extra permissions. Enable this to also detect activity in other apps. Shares only idle duration, never keys, pointer positions, app names, or window titles. Requires Accessibility.
translated: OpenClaw 可通过自身活动识别这台 Mac，无需额外权限。启用此选项还可检测其他应用中的活动。仅共享空闲时长，绝不共享按键、指针位置、应用名称或窗口标题。需要辅助功能权限。
会话已停止在设备上运行

text: Your saved sign-in for {host} stays here and isn’t sent.
translated: 您为 {host} 保存的登录信息会保留在本地，不会发送。

text: Default image-understanding prompt when an entry does not override it. Use a fixed prompt when consumers rely on stable descriptions.
translated: 条目未覆盖时使用的默认图像理解提示词。如果使用方依赖稳定的描述，请使用固定的提示词。

text: Couldn’t rebuild the Control UI. Fix the UI build error and retry.
translated: 无法重新构建 Control UI。请修复 UI 构建错误后重试。

text: Exact hostnames or IP literals allowed by browser SSRF policy checks. Keep the list minimal.
translated: 浏览器 SSRF 策略检查所允许的精确主机名或 IP 地址字面量。请尽量精简此列表。

text: Pattern pass that looks for recurring themes across the lookback window.
translated: 通过模式分析, 查找回溯时间窗口内反复出现的主题。
web_fetch 返回的最大字符数（超出部分将被截断）。

text: Couldn’t check the checkout. Select the project again to retry.
translated: 无法检查检出目录。请重新选择项目以重试。

text: The owner needs automation access to edit this automation. Transferring it pauses it and clears the previous owner’s saved access.
translated: 所有者需要自动化访问权限才能编辑此自动化。转移所有权会暂停自动化，并清除前任所有者已保存的访问授权。

text: Environment import and override settings used to supply runtime variables to the gateway process. Use this section to control shell-env loading and explicit variable injection behavior.
translated: 环境变量导入和覆盖设置，用于向 Gateway 进程提供运行时变量。使用此部分可控制 shell 环境变量加载和显式变量注入行为。

text: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Skip Verify
translated: 模型提供商请求代理 TLS 跳过验证

text: A session with this name already exists.
The durable projection will load when this browser reconnects.
translated: 此浏览器重新连接后，将加载持久化投影。

text: Treat replies to the bot's own messages as implicit mentions by default. Defaults to true for backward compatibility.
translated: 默认将对机器人自身消息的回复视为隐式提及。为保持向后兼容，默认值为 true。

text: Couldn’t create an agent. Check your account in Models and try again. {error}
translated: 无法创建智能体。请在“模型”中检查你的账户，然后重试。{error}
暂存内容超出字节数限制。

text: This plugin action is currently unavailable. Reopen the session menu.
translated: 此插件操作当前不可用。请重新打开会话菜单。

text: Maximum PDF file size in megabytes for the PDF tool (default: 10).
translated: PDF 工具允许的最大 PDF 文件大小，单位为 MB（默认：10）。

text: Allows client file and image uploads (default: true). Set false to reject attachments, workspace/terminal uploads, avatar uploads, and archive imports at the Gateway, including direct API requests. Changes apply without restarting. This is not a sandbox or a restriction on channel media, agent tools, or operator shell access.
translated: 允许客户端上传文件和图片（默认值：true）。设为 false 可在 Gateway 端拒绝附件、工作区/终端上传、头像上传和归档导入，包括通过直接 API 请求进行的这些操作。更改无需重启即可生效。这不是沙箱，也不会限制频道媒体、智能体工具或操作员的 shell 访问。

text: Cloud devices are unavailable because this connection doesn’t support session recovery. Reconnect or update the Gateway.
translated: 云设备不可用，因为此连接不支持会话恢复。请重新连接或更新 Gateway。
跳过工作区引导文件创建

text: Click Connect again after updating the Gateway secret.
translated: 更新 Gateway 密钥后，再次点击连接。

text: Couldn’t list that folder. Try again.
translated: 无法列出该文件夹的内容。请重试。
没有与搜索条件匹配的资源。

text: Access changed while you were making this update. Refresh and review its status before trying again.
translated: 在您进行此次更新期间，访问权限发生了变化。请刷新并查看其状态后重试。

text: Direct inbound debounce settings used before queue/turn processing starts. Configure this for provider-specific rapid message bursts from the same sender.
translated: 在队列或轮次处理开始前直接应用的入站消息防抖设置。可针对特定提供商中同一发送者短时间内连续发送多条消息的情况进行配置。

text: Couldn’t connect to {host} with the requested access. Approve the new request on the computer running OpenClaw.
translated: 无法以请求的访问权限连接到 {host}。请在运行 OpenClaw 的计算机上批准新请求。
此技能将由团队管理员管理。

text: Check the saved request. It won’t repeat a successful update.
translated: 请检查已保存的请求。此请求不会重复执行已成功的更新。

translated: 会话、浏览器和工具可能还有额外限制。

text: Required locators come from the provider. Existing fields are preserved even when the provider is unavailable.
translated: 所需的定位信息由提供商提供。即使提供商不可用，现有字段也会保留。

text: Cloud session disk space is critically low
translated: 云端会话磁盘空间严重不足

text: Managed profile on the remote computer that receives the cookies.
translated: 远程电脑上用于接收 Cookie 的托管配置文件。

text: Couldn’t refresh sessions after the move. The move was saved. Try again. {error}
translated: 移动后无法刷新会话。移动已保存。请重试。{error}

text: Optional provider/model for typed choices, scores, and boolean probabilities. Unset or empty disables decision calls. Supporting plugins send bounded task evidence to this provider; chat and utility models are unchanged.
translated: 可选的提供商/模型，用于生成带类型的选项、评分和布尔概率。未设置或为空时，将禁用决策调用。支持此功能的插件会将限定范围的任务依据发送给此提供商；聊天和实用模型保持不变。
操作员角色排除的模型
插件审批目标账户 ID

text: Cache hit rate = cache read / (input + cache read + cache write). Higher is better.
translated: 缓存命中率 = 缓存读取量 / (输入量 + 缓存读取量 + 缓存写入量). 越高越好。

按频道设置入站消息防抖（毫秒）

text: Applies to sidebar deletes. Stopping cloud devices or removing saved worktrees always asks.
translated: 适用于侧边栏中的删除操作。停止云设备或移除已保存的工作树时始终会要求确认。
桌面 — 仅供查看的画中画

text: Database engine selection. SQLite is the default; PostgreSQL is a supported alternative for the five configurable families. Doctor reports configured and observed engines and warns about mismatches, missing capabilities, or unavailable stores. See the PostgreSQL operator guide for platform and upgrade qualification limits.
translated: 数据库引擎选择。默认使用 SQLite；PostgreSQL 是五个可配置存储类别支持的替代引擎。Doctor 会报告已配置和实际检测到的引擎，并对引擎不匹配、功能缺失或存储不可用的情况发出警告。有关平台和升级的验证范围限制，请参阅 PostgreSQL 运维指南。

text: You need admin access to inspect session storage.
translated: 你需要管理员权限才能查看会话存储。

text: Couldn’t save the dashboard default. Check the connection and try again.
translated: 无法保存仪表板默认设置。请检查连接后重试。

text: Additional shared skill roots to scan at lowest precedence. Use this for sibling repos or shared skill packs that should be available without copying them into the OpenClaw workspace.
translated: 以最低优先级扫描的额外共享技能根目录。适用于同级仓库或共享技能包，无需将其复制到 OpenClaw 工作区即可使用。

text: Maps verified trusted-proxy or Tailscale identities to connection-only operator scope grants. Email keys match case-insensitively; grants augment device scopes before the connection scope cap is applied.
translated: 将已验证的受信任代理或 Tailscale 身份映射到仅对当前连接有效的操作员权限范围授权。电子邮件地址键的匹配不区分大小写；这些授权会在应用连接权限范围上限之前扩展设备权限范围。

text: You need admin access to use Browser.
translated: 您需要管理员权限才能使用浏览器。

text: Set per plugin in plugins.entries.{id}. Hooks outside these grants are blocked at load.
translated: 在 plugins.entries.{id} 中为每个插件单独设置。 加载时会阻止超出这些授权范围的钩子。

text: No missing evidence was reported for this projection.
translated: 此投影视图未报告任何缺失的证据。

text: Only admins can manage secrets. Ask an admin for access.
translated: 只有管理员可以管理密钥。请向管理员申请访问权限。

text: Try a wider date range or another identity to explore more history.
translated: 尝试扩大日期范围或选择其他身份，以查看更多历史记录。

text: Global opt-in for experimental assistance from the owning agent’s configured Decision model (default: false; requires explicit true). The effective decisionModel can be inherited from global defaults or selected per agent; an empty per-agent value disables assistance. Supported uses may send selected data to that provider and incur provider charges. See the Decision assistance documentation for supported uses, setup, and data handling. This setting does not gate explicit decision_evaluate calls, select providers, or grant actions.
translated: 全局启用所属智能体已配置的 Decision 模型提供的实验性辅助功能（默认值：false；必须显式设置为 true）。实际生效的 decisionModel 可继承自全局默认设置，也可为每个智能体单独选择；若智能体级别的值为空，则禁用辅助功能。受支持的用途可能会将选定的数据发送给该提供商，并产生提供商费用。有关支持的用途、设置和数据处理方式，请参阅 Decision 辅助功能文档。此设置不控制显式 decision_evaluate 调用的使用权限，不选择提供商，也不授予操作权限。

text: Optional DM session scope override for this route binding. For example, keep global session.dmScope="main" while using "per-account-channel-peer" for selected direct peers.
translated: 此路由绑定的可选私信会话范围覆盖设置。例如，保持全局 session.dmScope="main"，同时对选定的私信对象使用 "per-account-channel-peer"。

text: If using pnpm ui:dev, rebuild or restart the dev UI against the current checkout.
translated: 如果使用 pnpm ui:dev，请基于当前检出的代码重新构建或重启开发 UI。

text: macOS SSH host-key verification policy. "strict" requires an already trusted host key; "openssh" explicitly delegates to effective OpenSSH configuration.
translated: macOS SSH 主机密钥验证策略。"strict" 要求主机密钥已受信任；"openssh" 则明确委托给当前生效的 OpenSSH 配置处理。

text: {channel} is degraded — ask me what happened
translated: {channel} 运行异常 — 问我发生了什么
会话状态和 Gateway 维护。

text: Externally reachable HTTPS origin of the Gateway. Also the default browser origin when gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins is omitted. HTTP is allowed only for localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1]. Per-requester MCP OAuth uses it to build the callback URL at /oauth/mcp/callback; channel session links and plugin-generated viewer links use it to reach the Control UI and Gateway routes.
translated: 可从外部访问的 Gateway HTTPS 来源。省略 gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins 时，也用作默认浏览器来源。仅 localhost、127.0.0.1 或 [::1] 允许使用 HTTP。按请求方区分的 MCP OAuth 使用它构建路径为 /oauth/mcp/callback 的回调 URL；频道会话链接和插件生成的查看器链接使用它访问 Control UI 和 Gateway 路由。

text: No agents yet. Open Agents to add one.
translated: 尚无智能体。请打开“智能体”以添加一个。

text: Show desktop alerts for agent activity.
translated: 显示智能体活动的桌面通知。
请求往返耗时：{ms} 毫秒

text: These plugins add features to your memory engine. You can use more than one.
translated: 这些插件可为记忆引擎扩展功能。您可以同时使用多个插件。
已移除 {removed} 条重复的梦境条目。

text: This selection contains active work. Archiving stops work in the selected sessions.
translated: 所选会话中有正在进行的任务。归档将停止所选会话中的任务。

text: Automations attached to this session will appear here.
translated: 关联到此会话的自动化任务将显示在这里。

text: Clear the capture reservation. Snapshots and allocation choices stay. This won’t stop cloud devices or clean up provider resources.
translated: 清除快照捕获预留。快照和分配选项将保留。此操作不会停止云设备或清理提供商资源。

text: Web search is off in Settings. Remove this session’s override.
translated: 网页搜索已在设置中关闭。请移除此会话的覆盖设置。

text: Shared defaults for thread-bound session spawning and routing across supported channels. Configure global defaults here and override per channel only when behavior differs.
translated: 适用于受支持渠道的线程绑定会话创建与路由的共享默认设置。在此配置全局默认值，仅在行为不同时按渠道覆盖。

text: Exact hostnames or IP literals allowed for web_fetch, including otherwise blocked targets. Keep the list minimal.
translated: 允许 web_fetch 访问的精确主机名或 IP 字面量，包括原本被阻止的目标。请仅保留必要的列表项。

text: Stage trusted memories from earlier agent sessions. Dreaming promotes the useful ones into long-term memory.
translated: 暂存来自早期智能体会话的可信记忆。做梦机制会将有用的记忆转为长期记忆。

text: Requires the enabled Agents API plugin, a compatible API-key model, and a hosted environment. ChatGPT subscriptions are not supported.
translated: 需要已启用的 Agents API 插件、兼容的 API 密钥模型和托管环境。不支持 ChatGPT 订阅。

text: The web app already works. Add a channel only if you want to message OpenClaw from another service.
translated: 网页应用已可正常使用。仅当你想通过其他服务向 OpenClaw 发送消息时，才需要添加渠道。

text: Couldn’t load this image. Try again.
translated: 无法加载此图片。请重试。

text: Node browser routing ("auto" = prefer the host browser, use a single connected browser node when local capability is unavailable; "manual" = require an explicit node selection or configured pin; "off" = disable node routing).
translated: 节点浏览器路由（"auto" = 优先使用主机浏览器，本地功能不可用时使用单个已连接的浏览器节点；"manual" = 必须明确选择节点或配置固定节点；"off" = 禁用节点路由）。

text: Browser refused the Gateway WebSocket for security reasons. Check the Gateway WebSocket URL and browser security policy.
translated: 出于安全原因，浏览器拒绝了 Gateway WebSocket 连接。请检查 Gateway WebSocket URL 和浏览器安全策略。

text: Curated long-term facts and decisions for private sessions.
translated: 为私密会话整理的长期事实和决策。

translated: 控制映射执行结果是投递回目标渠道，还是仅静默处理。对于不应向用户发布输出的后台自动化任务，请禁用投递。

text: Durable multi-agent ownership generation marker. "explicit" means ambient channels, system-agent consults, Talk, cron, and bare CLI operations must resolve a surface-specific owner or stop when no owner can be identified. OpenClaw stamps this automatically when creating or migrating a fleet; omit it for a sole agent.

Differently named context-engine owners must be independently enabled or allowlisted and included in any non-empty allowlist. Plugin-owned tools outside the allowlist remain unavailable. Use plugins.deny or plugins.entries.<id>.enabled: false to block a plugin regardless of slot selection.

Explicit draft and conversation choices remain editable; Fast Mode and placement preferences are unchanged. Applies after browser refresh or reconnect.

translated: 允许提供转发客户端身份标头的上游代理 CIDR/IP 允许列表。请严格限制此列表的范围，防止不可信的中间节点冒充用户。

translated: 供操作人员查阅的审计历史记录，仅包含元数据且保留量有限。默认启用运行和工具记录；消息生命周期元数据涉及隐私，需单独选择启用。后台写入采用尽力而为的方式，并非无损的合规归档。

Agent commands, model actions, previews, and cloud devices keep the shared account. Finish work on a cloud device and bring it back to this computer before publishing with My GitHub. Connecting My GitHub changes no defaults.
translated: 仅在你选择使用“我的 GitHub”发布 PR 时，才会使用该账号。你需要拥有会话的写入权限，并且工作必须已在此计算机上完成并验收。智能体命令、模型操作、预览和云端设备仍使用共享账号。如果在云端设备上完成工作，请先将工作带回此计算机，再使用“我的 GitHub”发布。连接“我的 GitHub”不会更改任何默认设置。

text: {branch}: changes against the default branch, including uncommitted work
translated: {branch}：相对于默认分支的更改，包括尚未提交的内容

text: Paste the token from openclaw gateway auth-token --show into Gateway secret.
translated: 将 openclaw gateway auth-token --show 显示的令牌粘贴到 Gateway 密钥字段中。

translated: GitHub 登录请求被拒绝。准备好后请重新连接。

translated: 此 Gateway 地址无法打开终端。请使用 CLI 或不含查询字符串的 Gateway 地址。

text: This credential comes from {name} in the Gateway environment. Change that environment variable at its source. Its value is never shown here.
translated: 此凭据来自 Gateway 环境中的 {name}。请在来源处修改该环境变量。此处永远不会显示其值。
快速模式已重置为默认值。

text: Ordered allow/deny rules evaluated before the default action, for example `{ action: "deny", match: { channel: "discord" } }`. Put most specific rules first so broad rules do not shadow exceptions.
translated: 在执行默认操作之前按顺序评估的允许/拒绝规则，例如 `{ action: "deny", match: { channel: "discord" } }`。请将最具体的规则放在前面，以免宽泛的规则覆盖例外情况。

text: Speech-to-text may send audio to your configured transcription provider and incur provider usage. This library does not store or play raw audio.
translated: 语音转文字可能会将音频发送给您配置的转录服务提供商，并产生服务用量。本库不存储或播放原始音频。

text: Select the worker-session process boundary: "none" runs directly on the node host (default); "container" requires a working Docker-compatible engine and never falls back to host execution.
translated: 选择工作进程会话的进程边界："none" 表示直接在节点主机上运行（默认值）；"container" 要求有可用的 Docker 兼容引擎，且绝不会回退到主机执行。

text: High risk: visible to admins and plaintext to Gateway-hosted agent commands. The agent can print, transmit, or persist it. Applies from the next reply.
translated: 高风险：管理员可见，且 Gateway 托管的智能体命令可读取其明文。智能体可以输出、传输或持久化存储该值。从下一次回复起生效。

text: ACP runtime defaults for this agent when runtime.type=acp. Binding-level ACP overrides still take precedence per conversation.
translated: 当 runtime.type=acp 时，此智能体的 ACP 运行时默认设置。对于每个对话，绑定级别的 ACP 覆盖设置仍具有更高优先级。

text: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that runs on your own computer and meets you in the channels you already use: Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp, and 20+ more. State, memory, and credentials stay on your hardware, and models are plugins you can swap without changing anything else. No paid tier, no hosted service, no token: MIT-licensed and stewarded by the independent OpenClaw Foundation.
translated: OpenClaw 是一款开源 AI 助手，在你自己的电脑上运行，并通过你日常使用的渠道与你互动：Discord、iMessage、Slack、Teams、Telegram、WhatsApp，以及其他 20 多个渠道。状态、记忆和凭据均保留在你的硬件上，模型则以插件形式提供，可随时替换，无需更改其他任何内容。没有付费套餐，没有托管服务，也没有代币：采用 MIT 许可证，由独立的 OpenClaw Foundation 管理。

text: Draft my standup update from yesterday's commits, merged pull requests, and open review threads. Three bullets max: done, doing, blocked.
translated: 根据昨天的提交、已合并的拉取请求和尚未结束的审查讨论，起草我的站会汇报。最多三点：已完成、进行中、受阻。

text: No skills yet. Search ClawHub to add one.
translated: 暂无技能。搜索 ClawHub 以添加技能。

text: Enter a duration of at least 1m, such as 45m or 2h, or leave suspend after empty.
translated: 请输入至少 1m 的时长，例如 45m 或 2h，或将挂起前的空闲时长留空。

text: Decision receipts are read-only. This view cannot approve, edit, or repeat an action.
translated: 决策回执为只读。此视图无法批准、编辑或重复执行操作。

text: Browser runtime controls for local or remote CDP attachment, profile routing, and screenshot/snapshot behavior. Keep defaults unless your automation workflow requires custom browser transport settings.
translated: 浏览器运行时控制设置，用于本地或远程 CDP 连接、配置文件路由以及截图/快照行为。除非自动化工作流需要自定义浏览器传输设置，否则请保留默认值。

text: Maps cached GitHub identity logins to configured role names, matching case-insensitively after trimming. Invalid logins, duplicate normalized logins, and unknown roles are rejected. Profiles without a cached GitHub identity use their explicit assignment or default role.
translated: 将缓存的 GitHub 身份登录名映射到已配置的角色名称，匹配时去除首尾空白并忽略大小写。无效的登录名、规范化后重复的登录名以及未知角色均会被拒绝。没有缓存的 GitHub 身份的配置档案使用其显式分配的角色或默认角色。

text: Enables collector-mode subagents and agents_wait. Default is on; set false to opt out.
translated: 启用收集器模式的子智能体和 agents_wait。默认开启；设为 false 可关闭。

text: Optional per-agent overrides for skills subsystem budgets. Use this when an agent needs a different skills prompt budget without introducing a second generic context-limits path.
translated: 可选的单智能体技能子系统预算覆盖设置。当智能体需要不同的技能提示词预算，且不希望引入第二套通用上下文限制配置路径时，可使用此设置。

text: Per-provider tool allow/deny overrides keyed by channel/provider ID to tailor capabilities by surface. Use this when one provider needs stricter controls than global tool policy. exec.mode sets a restrict-only host exec ceiling for turns on that provider or provider/model (it never drops mandatory approvals or loosens a stricter mode), so mode "auto" puts only that model's exec misses behind the exec reviewer.
translated: 按渠道/提供商 ID 配置各提供商的工具允许/拒绝覆盖规则，以针对不同使用界面调整可用能力。当某个提供商需要比全局工具策略更严格的控制时，可使用此配置。exec.mode 为该提供商或提供商/模型上的交互轮次设置主机 exec 权限上限，且只能收紧限制（绝不会取消强制审批或放宽更严格的模式），因此模式 "auto" 仅会将该模型未命中规则的 exec 请求交由 exec 审核器处理。

Off by default; while off the Gateway starts no child process, opens no tunnel sockets, and contacts no OpenClaw ID, Discovery or relay service.
translated: 实验性 OpenClaw ID 远程访问（实验室）。启用后，网关会监管一个隧道子进程，接受来自已获准设备的 iroh 连接，并将其代理到此网关。默认关闭；关闭时，网关不会启动任何子进程、打开任何隧道套接字，也不会联系任何 OpenClaw ID、发现服务或中继服务。

text: You can view command approvals and device bindings, but only admins can change them.
translated: 你可以查看命令审批和设备绑定，但只有管理员才能更改它们。

translated: 启用 web_fetch 工具（轻量级 HTTP 抓取）。

translated: 此连接没有添加账户的权限。请向管理员申请访问权限，然后重新连接 Gateway。

text: When true (default), suppress repeated ACP status/tool projection lines in a turn while keeping raw ACP events unchanged.

translated: 控制日志和遥测接入路径中诊断插桩输出的总开关。默认启用；仅在受严格限制的环境中设为 false。

translated: 允许跨不同提供商发送消息（默认值：true）。设为 false 可阻止跨提供商发送消息。

translated: 首条消息未发送。请先检查该消息，再重试发送这些后续消息。

text: SSH-verified auto-approval for first-time node-role device pairing (default: enabled). text: Thinking level used only for embedded OpenClaw compaction summaries: "off", "minimal", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "adaptive", "max", "ultra", or "inherit". Defaults to the provider compaction preference, otherwise "low"; native local Ollama prefers "off". Set "inherit" to reuse the session level. Explicit settings override provider defaults, and the selected level is clamped to the actual compaction model/runtime. Native Codex app-server compaction ignores this setting because its compact request has no per-operation thinking override, and OpenClaw logs a warning.
translated: 仅用于 OpenClaw 内嵌压缩摘要的思考级别："off"、"minimal"、"low"、"medium"、"high"、"xhigh"、"adaptive"、"max"、"ultra" 或 "inherit"。默认使用提供商的压缩偏好设置，否则使用 "low"；原生本地 Ollama 优先使用 "off"。设为 "inherit" 可沿用会话级别。显式设置会覆盖提供商的默认值，所选级别会被限制在实际压缩模型或运行时支持的范围内。原生 Codex app-server 压缩会忽略此设置，因为其压缩请求不支持按操作覆盖思考级别，OpenClaw 会记录一条警告。

text: Delivery channel override for mapping outputs (for example "last", "telegram", "discord", "slack", "signal", "imessage", or "msteams"). Keep channel overrides explicit to avoid accidental cross-channel sends.
translated: 覆盖映射输出的投递渠道（例如 "last"、"telegram"、"discord"、"slack"、"signal"、"imessage" 或 "msteams"）。请明确指定渠道覆盖值，以免意外跨渠道发送。

text: Start the application in a portal.
translated: 在门户中启动应用程序。

text: Fallback ACP target agent id used when ACP spawns do not specify an explicit target.
translated: 创建 ACP 会话时未明确指定目标所使用的备用 ACP 目标智能体 ID。

text: Additional HTTP request headers sent with OpenTelemetry export requests, often used for tenant auth or routing. Keep secrets in env-backed values and avoid unnecessary header sprawl.
translated: 随 OpenTelemetry 导出请求发送的附加 HTTP 请求头，通常用于租户身份验证或路由。请通过环境变量提供密钥值，并避免添加不必要的请求头。

translated: 不编入目录的来源："openclaw"、"mcp" 或 "client"。与 name 同时存在时，两者需同时匹配。

text: Enter a new key to replace the stored credential.
translated: 输入新密钥以替换已存储的凭据。

text: None keeps both pages plain without removing your saved image or choices.
translated: 选择“无”可让两个页面保持纯色背景，不会删除已保存的图片或设置。

text: Default supplemental context visibility for fetched quote/thread/history content: "all" (keep all context), "allowlist" (only allowlisted senders), or "allowlist_quote" (allowlist + keep explicit quotes).
translated: 获取的引用、话题串和历史内容的默认补充上下文可见性："all"（保留所有上下文）、"allowlist"（仅保留允许列表中发送者的内容）或 "allowlist_quote"（允许列表加上显式引用）。

translated: tweakcn 返回了无效的主题文件。

translated: 此连接没有 operator.read 权限，因此无法加载保留的运行身份。

text: View and control this computer from Systems. Enabled by default. Requires an authenticated local VNC server. Changes briefly reconnect this computer; a new capability may need pairing approval.
translated: 从系统页面查看并控制此电脑。默认启用。需要运行需身份验证的本地 VNC 服务器。更改会使此电脑短暂断开并重新连接；新增功能可能需要配对批准。

text: Allow other sessions to initiate messages to this session. Ask requires human approval; Never blocks them.
translated: 允许其他会话主动向此会话发送消息。“询问”需要人工批准；“从不”则会阻止接收。

text: Hang on while the Gateway gets ready.
translated: 请稍候，网关正在准备就绪。

text: Your Gateway access does not allow managing browser notifications.
translated: 你的 Gateway 访问权限不允许管理浏览器通知。
连接已断开。正在等待重新连接…

text: Named browser profile connection map used for explicit routing to CDP ports or URLs with optional metadata. Keep profile names consistent and avoid overlapping endpoint definitions.
translated: 命名浏览器配置文件的连接映射，用于显式路由到 CDP 端口或 URL，并可附带元数据。请保持配置文件名称一致，避免端点定义重叠。

text: Prepares unassigned cloud devices per eligible project after a successful session. Leave empty for one; zero disables reserves. Ready devices incur running-device charges.
translated: 会话成功后，为每个符合条件的项目准备未分配的云设备。留空则默认为一台；设为零会禁用预留设备。就绪设备会产生设备运行费用。

text: Optional recipient override for failure alerts.
translated: 可选，用于覆盖失败告警的接收方。

text: Promotion score an entry must reach.
translated: 条目获得提升所需达到的评分。

text: Refresh to update status and health snapshots. Heartbeat data updates live.
translated: 刷新以更新状态和健康状况快照。心跳数据实时更新。

text: Maximum live managed worktrees across all agents and repositories (default: 4096). Evicts merged or squashed branches first, then oldest idle worktrees, including unsaved data. Live runs are protected; raise this value if they occupy the cap. Disk-space admission still applies.
translated: 所有智能体和仓库中现存托管工作树的数量上限（默认值：4096）。优先清理已合并或已压缩合并的分支，然后清理闲置时间最长的工作树，包括其中未保存的数据。正在运行的任务会受到保护；如果这些任务占满配额，请提高此值。磁盘空间准入限制仍然适用。
浏览器登录 · 已保存的账户

text: Optional request overrides for model-provider requests, including extra headers, auth overrides, proxy routing, TLS client settings, and optional allowPrivateNetwork for trusted self-hosted endpoints. Use these only when your upstream or enterprise network path requires transport customization.
translated: 用于模型提供商请求的可选覆盖设置，包括额外请求头、身份验证覆盖设置、代理路由、TLS 客户端设置，以及用于受信任的自托管端点的可选 allowPrivateNetwork。仅在上游服务或企业网络路径需要自定义传输配置时使用。

text: Check the approval link and your access, then try again.
translated: 请检查审批链接和你的访问权限，然后重试。

text: There’s a place for you in the AI future. Join the Community on Reddit, Discord, and X.
translated: AI 的未来，也有你的一席之地。加入我们在 Reddit、Discord 和 X 上的社区。
操作员角色访问策略插件

text: Held when the provider paused this session. Review the findings before retrying this message.
translated: 提供方暂停此会话时，这条消息已被暂缓发送。请先查看检查结果，再重试发送此消息。

text: Optional session-key filters matched as substring or regex-style patterns, for example `["discord:", "^agent:ops:"]`. Use narrow patterns so only intended approval contexts are forwarded.
translated: 可选的会话键筛选条件，按子字符串或正则表达式风格的模式匹配，例如 `["discord:", "^agent:ops:"]`。请使用范围较窄的模式，确保仅转发预期上下文中的审批。

text: Recent exec, plugin, and system-agent approvals.
translated: 近期的执行、插件和系统智能体审批。
没有符合这些筛选条件的消息。

translated: 自动化 Webhook 允许访问私有网络（危险）

text: Choose another model to keep this session’s current execution restrictions.
translated: 请选择其他模型，以保留此会话当前的执行限制。

text: Exact hostnames that use authenticated blind CONNECT tunnels for certificate-pinned clients. Sentinels remain ciphertext and will fail vendor authentication instead of exposing plaintext.
translated: 为采用证书固定的客户端使用经身份验证的盲 CONNECT 隧道的精确主机名。哨兵值保持为密文，将导致供应商身份验证失败，而不会暴露明文。

text: Event automations need an agent task in a separate or existing session.
translated: 事件自动化需要在单独的会话或现有会话中设置智能体任务。

text: Connect to the Gateway to check realtime voice readiness.
translated: 连接到 Gateway 以检查实时语音是否就绪。

text: Check for completed actions before running again.
translated: 再次运行前，请检查是否已有操作完成。

text: Automatic uses the primary model provider's recommended small model when available. Generated titles otherwise use the primary model.
translated: 自动模式会使用主模型提供商推荐的小型模型（如有）. 否则，使用主模型生成标题。

text: Choose a model with an available local runtime before selecting a device or cloud worker.
translated: 请先选择具有可用本地运行时的模型，再选择设备或云端工作节点。
自动化任务默认投递话题

text: Preferred image resize side for balanced compression. Leave unset to use OpenClaw's conservative default.
translated: 用于均衡压缩效果的首选图像缩放边长。留空则使用 OpenClaw 的保守默认值。

text: Chat, talk, approve actions, and share into OpenClaw from iOS.
translated: 在 iOS 上聊天、语音交流、批准操作，并将内容分享到 OpenClaw。

text: Switch to this agent’s session to view its tool preview.
translated: 切换到此智能体的会话以查看其工具预览。

text: Progress saved by this session appears here.
translated: 此会话保存的进度将显示在这里。

text: Determines whether pruning and disk-budget policies are only reported ("warn") or actively applied ("enforce"). Keep "warn" during rollout and switch to "enforce" after validating safe thresholds. Cold storage has its own explicit enabled setting.
translated: 决定是仅报告修剪和磁盘空间预算策略的执行情况（"warn"），还是实际执行这些策略（"enforce"）。在逐步上线期间保持 "warn"，验证安全阈值后再切换为 "enforce"。冷存储有独立的显式 enabled 设置。

text: Could not load people. Try again.
translated: 无法加载人员列表。 请重试。

text: This session’s workspace isn’t a Git checkout.
translated: 此会话的工作区不是 Git 工作副本。

text: Optional music-generation model (provider/model) used by the shared music generation capability.
translated: 共享音乐生成功能使用的可选音乐生成模型（provider/model）。

text: Waiting for subscription status. Refresh to check activation.
translated: 正在等待订阅状态。请刷新以检查激活情况。

text: Timeout in seconds for web_search requests.
translated: web_search 请求的超时时间，以秒为单位。

text: Remote connection transport: "direct" uses configured URL connectivity, while "ssh" tunnels through SSH. Use SSH when you need encrypted tunnel semantics without exposing remote ports.
translated: 远程连接传输方式："direct" 使用配置的 URL 进行连接，而 "ssh" 通过 SSH 建立隧道。如果需要加密隧道且不希望暴露远程端口，请使用 SSH。

text: Optional idle eviction for OpenClaw session MCP runtimes in milliseconds. Unset or 0 keeps runtimes alive until session cleanup or Gateway shutdown. Positive values round down; active leases and pending acquisitions prevent eviction. Run-owned runtimes still retire when their one-shot run ends.
translated: 可选的 OpenClaw 会话 MCP 运行时空闲回收时间，以毫秒为单位。未设置或设为 0 时，运行时会保持存活，直到会话清理或 Gateway 关闭。正值向下取整；活跃租约和待处理的获取请求会阻止回收。归属于单次运行的运行时仍会在该次运行结束时终止。

text: Per-agent automation defaults keyed by agent id. Each automation uses the entry for its effective agent (its agentId, else the agent in its session key, else the default agent).
translated: 以智能体 ID 为键的各智能体自动化默认设置。每项自动化使用其实际生效智能体对应的条目（优先使用 agentId，其次使用会话键中的智能体，最后使用默认智能体）。

text: Absolute path to the VNC password file. Omit on macOS to enter account credentials when opening the desktop viewer.
translated: VNC 密码文件的绝对路径。在 macOS 上可省略，以便在打开桌面查看器时输入账户凭据。

text: Couldn’t open this app’s session. Try again.
translated: 无法打开此应用的会话，请重试。

text: Moves inactive transcripts into compressed JSONL archives while retaining session metadata. Archive files become required history and must be included in backups. Changes apply without restarting the Gateway.
translated: 将不活跃的转录移入压缩的 JSONL 归档，同时保留会话元数据。归档文件将成为必需的历史记录，必须纳入备份。更改无需重启 Gateway 即可生效。

text: Applies to everyone on this Gateway.
translated: 适用于此 Gateway 上的所有人。

text: Only the session creator or an admin can make this change.
translated: 只有会话创建者或管理员才能进行此更改。

text: Controls when typing starts for agents: "never", "instant", "thinking", or "message". Per-agent typingMode overrides this default.
translated: 控制智能体何时开始显示正在输入状态："never"、"instant"、"thinking" 或 "message"。各智能体的 typingMode 会覆盖此默认值。

text: You need read access to browse folders. Ask an admin for access.
translated: 你需要读取权限才能浏览文件夹。请向管理员申请权限。
{pageCount} 个页面上有 {questionCount} 个问题

text: Discovery preferences for setup and read-only setup history.
translated: 初始设置的发现偏好和只读设置历史记录。

text: Optional low-level agent runtime policy for this specific model. Model runtime policy overrides the provider runtime policy.
translated: 此特定模型的可选底层智能体运行时策略。模型运行时策略会覆盖提供商运行时策略。

text: Continue only if you started this sign-in. If someone sent you this code, cancel.
translated: 仅当此次登录由您发起时才继续。如果此代码是他人发送给您的，请取消。
{total} 个会话中有 {shown} 个匹配

text: Agent-specific settings override these defaults. View each agent's model in Agents → Overview.
translated: 智能体专属设置会覆盖这些默认值。在智能体 → 概览中查看各智能体的模型。

text: Auto-start setup is unavailable for this provider. Existing fields remain editable. Check the provider's setup documentation, enable its plugin, then refresh health.
translated: 此提供方不支持自动启动设置。现有字段仍可编辑。请查看提供方的设置文档，启用其插件，然后刷新健康状态。

text: Couldn’t load your profile. Try again.
translated: 无法加载你的个人资料。请重试。

text: GitHub {kind} was dispatched; its remote outcome may still be unknown.
translated: GitHub {kind} 已发出; 其远程结果可能仍未知。

text: Make sure it isn’t in use elsewhere. Beamed sessions are deleted permanently. Sessions kept by another tool, such as Codex, are archived there and may be restorable.
translated: 请确认此会话未在其他地方使用。Beamed 会话将被永久删除。由其他工具（如 Codex）保存的会话将在相应工具中归档，之后可能可以恢复。

text: Terminal UI footer display settings. Keep optional context compact so session, model, goal, and token information stay readable.
translated: 终端界面页脚显示设置。请精简可选的上下文内容，以确保会话、模型、目标和 token 信息清晰易读。

text: Automations need a verified session identity. Reopen this session and try again.
translated: 自动化需要经过验证的会话身份。请重新打开此会话后重试。

text: Connecting or removing an account below applies to new replies using System GitHub.
translated: 在下方连接或移除账户将对使用系统 GitHub 的新回复生效。
下次运行计划于 {time} 执行。

text: The Windows companion connects your PC as an OpenClaw device.
translated: Windows 配套应用将你的 PC 连接为 OpenClaw 设备。

text: Couldn't copy the request. Select and copy the text below, then send it to your workspace admin.
translated: 无法复制申请。请选中并复制下方文本，然后发送给工作区管理员。

text: Couldn’t load your agents. Reconnect and try again.
translated: 无法加载你的智能体。请重新连接后重试。

text: Queued attachments are missing or unreadable. This may be a stale copy from another tab. Check the conversation, then discard this row and attach the files again if needed. No new message was sent.
translated: 排队中的附件丢失或无法读取。 这可能是来自另一个标签页的过期副本。 请检查对话, 然后丢弃此行并根据需要重新添加文件。 未发送任何新消息。

text: Continuously copy this Mac's logged-in cookies for the domains below into the remote OpenClaw browser profile. Off by default.
translated: 持续将此 Mac 上以下域名的登录 Cookie 复制到远程 OpenClaw 浏览器配置文件中。默认关闭。

text: Default timeout in milliseconds for this plugin's typed hooks, capped at 600000. When unset, each hook uses the plugin's declared timeout or the Gateway's per-hook policy; there is no single fixed default. Per-hook values in hooks.timeouts take precedence.
translated: 此插件的类型化钩子的默认超时时间（毫秒），上限为 600000。未设置时，每个钩子使用插件声明的超时时间或 Gateway 的逐钩子策略；没有统一的固定默认值。hooks.timeouts 中针对各钩子设置的值优先。

text: Voice wake trigger editing is not enabled on this Gateway.
translated: 此 Gateway 未启用语音唤醒词编辑功能。

text: Configured internal hook entry records used to register concrete runtime handlers and metadata. Keep entries explicit and versioned so production behavior is auditable.
translated: 已配置的内部钩子条目记录，用于注册具体的运行时处理程序和元数据。请明确定义条目并进行版本管理，以便审计生产环境中的行为。

text: Byte threshold for preflight local compaction in the built-in runtime (bytes or strings like "20mb"). For Codex app-server, bounds fresh-thread history seeds instead: one host summary attempt only when unsummarized history would be omitted, never on ordinary turns or after native /compact. Set to 0 or leave unset to disable. Native rollout-size and token fuses are unchanged.
translated: 内置运行时在预检阶段执行本地压缩的字节阈值（字节数或 "20mb" 这样的字符串）。对于 Codex app-server，此设置改为限制新会话的初始历史记录：仅当未总结的历史记录将被省略时，才尝试一次由宿主生成的摘要；普通轮次中或原生 /compact 之后均不会尝试。设为 0 或留空可禁用。原生 rollout 大小限制和 token 熔断机制保持不变。

text: Host this service credential may access. Omit for github.com; set to gateway.github.host for Enterprise project discovery and account metadata.
translated: 此服务凭据可访问的主机。对于 github.com，可省略此项；若要发现 Enterprise 项目并获取账户元数据，请将其设置为 gateway.github.host 的值。

text: You need write access to check Git for this folder. Ask an admin for access.
translated: 你需要写入权限才能检查此文件夹的 Git 状态。请向管理员申请权限。

text: Directories to prepend to PATH for exec runs (gateway/sandbox).
translated: 执行时添加到 PATH 开头的目录（gateway/sandbox）。

text: Add OpenClaw from the Chrome Web Store on this device, then verify the connection.
translated: 在此设备上从 Chrome Web Store 添加 OpenClaw，然后验证连接。

text: Pin browser routing to a specific node id or name (optional).
translated: 将浏览器路由固定到指定的节点 ID 或名称（可选）。
未报告任何 CI 检查。

text: Configure the server and choose where it’s enabled.
translated: 配置服务器并选择启用范围。
智能体提供商覆盖配置

text: Focused per-agent-context budget defaults for selected high-volume excerpts and injected prompt blocks. Use this to tune bounded read/injection sizes without reopening any unbounded call paths.
translated: 针对选定的大容量摘录和注入提示词块，为每个智能体上下文设置专用的默认预算。使用此设置可调整受限的读取和注入大小，而不会重新开放任何不受限制的调用路径。

text: Couldn’t verify access. Check your connection and try again.
translated: 无法验证访问权限。请检查连接后重试。

text: On this Mac, open System Settings → General → Sharing. Turn on Screen Sharing, or allow this computer’s account to Observe and Control in Remote Management, then check again.
translated: 在此 Mac 上，打开 System Settings → General → Sharing。开启 Screen Sharing，或在 Remote Management 中允许此电脑的账户执行 Observe 和 Control，然后再次检查。

text: Ask an admin to approve this browser in Devices.
translated: 请联系管理员，在设备页面中批准此浏览器。

text: Couldn’t complete this app request. Try again.
translated: 无法完成此应用请求。请重试。
Exec 安全二进制程序配置

text: Deprecated migration guard for mode='serve'. If an external Funnel still targets the ordinary Gateway listener, OpenClaw leaves exposure unchanged and warns that only plugin-authenticated webhooks remain usable until password auth is configured and mode is migrated to 'funnel'.
translated: 用于 mode='serve' 的已弃用迁移保护机制。如果外部 Funnel 仍指向普通 Gateway 监听器，OpenClaw 会保持对外开放方式不变，并发出警告：在配置密码认证并将模式迁移为 'funnel' 之前，只有经过插件认证的 webhook 仍可使用。

text: Remote access is already set up. Close this dialog and check its status in the account menu.
translated: 远程访问已设置。请关闭此对话框，并在账户菜单中查看其状态。
此浏览器无法列出摄像头。

text: Scored promotion pass that graduates short-term entries into memory.
translated: 通过评分筛选, 将短期条目提升为记忆。

text: Timeout in milliseconds for relay send requests from the gateway to the APNs relay (default: 10000). Increase for slower relays or networks, or lower to fail wake attempts faster.
translated: Gateway 向 APNs 中继发送请求的超时时间，单位为毫秒（默认值：10000）。中继或网络较慢时可增大此值，也可减小此值以更快地判定唤醒尝试失败。

text: Queue a system notice in the owning agent's Home session when a session is created (default: true). Notices include available title and creator metadata and are read on the next Home turn or scheduled automation. Set false to disable; drafts, incognito, internal sessions, and scheduled cron runs are excluded.
translated: 创建会话时，在所属智能体的 Home 会话中将一条系统通知加入队列（默认值：true）。通知包含可用的标题和创建者元数据，并会在 Home 的下一轮交互或计划自动化任务中读取。设为 false 可禁用；草稿、无痕会话、内部会话和计划 cron 运行不在此列。

text: This lobster is not unlocked in this browser. Using Default until it is.
translated: 此龙虾尚未在此浏览器中解锁。解锁前将使用默认图标。

text: Global MCP server definitions managed by OpenClaw. Embedded OpenClaw and other runtime adapters can consume these servers without storing them inside runtime-owned project settings.
translated: 由 OpenClaw 管理的全局 MCP 服务器定义。嵌入式 OpenClaw 和其他运行时适配器可以使用这些服务器，无需将其存储在运行时所属的项目设置中。

text: Release channel, automatic updates, and current update status.
translated: 发布渠道、自动更新和当前更新状态。

text: Unified `progress_card` status tool for durable plans and narrative notes in parent sessions. Enabled by default; set false to opt out. Always unavailable to subagents.
translated: 统一的 `progress_card` 状态工具，用于在父会话中记录持久化计划和叙述性备注。默认启用；设为 false 可禁用。子智能体始终无法使用此工具。

text: Discovery service that mirrors the claw descriptor and membership snapshot and relays mailbox messages. It is untrusted: every statement it returns is verified against the claw's pinned owner root.
translated: 用于镜像 claw 描述符和成员资格快照，并转发邮箱消息的发现服务。此服务不受信任：它返回的每条声明都会根据 claw 固定的所有者信任根进行验证。
正在将旧上下文窗口化为养分…

text: This security policy or resource setup does not support relative resources in Preview. Use Source or Download for the original file.
translated: 当前安全策略或资源配置不支持在预览中使用相对路径资源。请使用“源文件”或“下载”查看原始文件。

text: Shared with everyone, no login required.
translated: 已向所有人共享，无需登录。

text: Session setup was interrupted and the temporary session was cleaned up. Your prompt is kept here.
translated: 会话设置已中断，临时会话已清理。你的提示词保留在此处。
默认将参与讨论串视为隐式提及

text: Teach me one useful phrase in Japanese: the phrase, how to pronounce it, its literal meaning, and when to use it. Keep it under five lines.
translated: 教我一句实用的日语：包括短语、发音、字面含义和使用场景。请控制在五行以内。

text: Stop work on any attached device, then delete the session entry and archive its transcript.
translated: 停止所有关联设备上的工作，然后删除会话条目并归档其对话记录。

text: Default image input size limit for configured and auto-detected models. Set this to match provider payload limits and deployment bandwidth.
translated: 已配置和自动检测到的模型的默认图像输入大小限制。请根据提供商的载荷限制和部署环境的带宽设置此值。

text: Default browser profile name selected when callers do not explicitly choose a profile. Use a stable low-privilege profile as the default to reduce accidental cross-context state use.
translated: 调用方未明确选择配置文件时使用的默认浏览器配置文件名称。请使用稳定的低权限配置文件作为默认值，以减少意外跨上下文使用状态的情况。

text: Approximate region/state sent to native Codex web search.
translated: 发送给原生 Codex 网页搜索的大致地区或州。

text: Native CLI sessions use a specific device. Reset this draft and choose a device for the native CLI.
translated: 原生 CLI 会话需要使用指定设备。请重置此草稿，并为原生 CLI 选择一台设备。

text: DM access approved. Couldn’t set the command owner. Ask an admin to set one.
translated: 已批准私信访问。未能设置命令所有者。请联系管理员设置。

text: Reconnect to review this approval and record a decision.
translated: 请重新连接，以查看此审批并记录审批决定。

text: Audio playback was blocked. Allow sound for this site, then click Unmute desktop audio again.
translated: 音频播放被阻止。请允许此网站播放声音，然后再次点击“取消桌面音频静音”。

text: Allow this paired node to host sessions from exact bundles installed by its Gateway (default: false).
translated: 允许此已配对节点托管会话，但必须使用其 Gateway 安装的完全相同的软件包（默认值：false）。

text: Control when this job sends repeated-failure alerts.
translated: 控制此任务何时发送连续失败告警。

text: Match rule object for deciding when a binding applies, including channel and optional account/peer constraints. Keep rules narrow to avoid accidental agent takeover across contexts.
translated: 用于决定绑定何时适用的匹配规则对象，包括渠道及可选的账户或对端限制。请缩小规则的匹配范围，避免智能体意外接管其他上下文。

text: Whether the last wizard run targeted "local" or "remote" setup.
translated: 上次向导运行是针对 "local" 还是 "remote" 设置。

text: Optional directory roots restricting in-place sessions to those roots and their subdirectories. Unset allows any existing directory except filesystem roots and private worker storage; [] disables device-folder sessions. Use absolute or ~/ paths. Existing files stay on the device; session deletion never removes these folders. Requires workerRuns.enabled.
translated: 可选的根目录列表，用于将原地会话限制在这些目录及其子目录中。不设置时，允许使用除文件系统根目录和工作进程私有存储目录之外的任何现有目录；[] 表示禁用设备文件夹会话。请使用绝对路径或 ~/ 路径。现有文件会保留在设备上；删除会话绝不会移除这些文件夹。需要启用 workerRuns.enabled。
队列中的消息仍处于暂存状态。

text: Couldn’t start this session. Try again.
translated: 无法启动此会话。请重试。

text: Exact hostnames only, one per line or comma-separated. No wildcards or ports.
translated: 仅支持精确的主机名, 每行一个或用逗号分隔。 不支持通配符或端口。

text: Optional thread/topic target for channels that support threaded delivery of forwarded approvals. Use this to keep approval traffic contained in operational threads instead of main channels.
translated: 可选的线程或话题目标，适用于支持在线程中投递转发审批的渠道。使用此选项可将审批消息集中在运维线程中，而非主渠道中。

text: Maximum total characters retained across all loaded daily memory files in the startup prelude (default: 2800). Additional files are truncated from the prelude once this cap is reached.
translated: 启动前导内容中，所有已加载的每日记忆文件保留的最大总字符数（默认值：2800）。达到此上限后，其余文件内容将在前导内容中被截断。

text: Your account when you choose it to publish a PR.
translated: 选择此账号发布 PR 时使用的个人账号。

text: Optional condition checks, delivery guarantees, schedule jitter, and model controls.
translated: 可选的条件检查、投递保障、调度抖动和模型控制。

text: Couldn’t save this message. Free browser storage or reconnect to send it.
translated: 无法保存此消息。请释放浏览器存储空间，或重新连接以发送消息。

text: Dedicated loopback HTTP port receiving the private wildcard HTTPS proxy. Must differ from the Gateway port. This is the backend port, not the public HTTPS port.
translated: 用于接收私有通配符 HTTPS 代理转发请求的专用环回 HTTP 端口。必须与 Gateway 端口不同。这是后端端口，而非公共 HTTPS 端口。

text: Native settings returned an invalid edit result

text: This file is missing. Saving will create it in the agent workspace.
translated: 此文件缺失。保存时将在智能体工作区中创建。

translated: 你有权发送消息和进行更改。

translated: 没有可供显示的唯一已验证 GitHub 登录账号。

text: Sets the global default for new sessions. Auto starts fast and returns to standard after the model's configured interval. On requests fast mode, Off requests standard, and Ultrafast requests the Ultrafast service tier when available. Saved preferences remain unchanged when capabilities change.
translated: 设置新会话的全局默认模式。“自动”会以快速模式启动，并在模型配置的时间间隔后恢复标准模式。“开启”请求快速模式，“关闭”请求标准模式，“超快”则在可用时请求超快服务层级。模型能力变化时，已保存的偏好设置保持不变。

text: The server was saved but is still disabled. Couldn’t enable it for this session. {error}
translated: 服务器已保存，但仍处于禁用状态。无法为当前会话启用该服务器。{error}

text: 1 setting in this config can only be edited as text: {paths}
translated: 此配置中有 1 项设置只能以文本形式编辑: {paths}

text: Usage data may be incomplete. Automatic checks paused; select Refresh to check again.
translated: 用量数据可能不完整。自动检查已暂停; 选择刷新以重新检查。

text: This device hasn’t reported resource statistics.
translated: 此设备尚未上报资源统计信息。
默认启用机器人循环防护

text: This plugin action is currently unavailable. Try again from the current view.
translated: 此插件操作当前不可用。请在当前视图中重试。
按顺序排列的备用音乐生成模型（provider/model）。

text: Queued messages stay held. Review and retry each message separately after continuation is accepted.
translated: 队列中的消息将继续暂存。继续请求被接受后，请逐条审查并重试。

text: The pending input changed or is being edited. Review it before refreshing. It hasn’t been discarded.
translated: 待发送的输入内容已更改或正在编辑。请在刷新前检查。内容尚未被丢弃。

text: Additional directories searched for internal hook modules beyond default load paths. Keep this minimal and controlled to reduce accidental module shadowing.
translated: 除默认加载路径之外，用于搜索内部钩子模块的附加目录。请尽量减少这些目录的数量并加以管控，以减少意外的模块遮蔽。

text: This theme hides Lobsterdex. Your collection and preferences are preserved.
translated: 此主题会隐藏 Lobsterdex。你的收藏和偏好设置将予以保留。

text: Couldn’t check sign-in status. Check again or cancel this attempt.
translated: 无法检查登录状态。请再次检查或取消本次尝试。

text: Choose a key that matches this setting’s constraints.
translated: 请选择符合此设置约束条件的键。

text: Condition-triggered automations must run at least every 30 seconds.
translated: 条件触发的自动化运行间隔必须至少为 30 秒。
启用浏览器标签页清理
隐藏 {count} 行未修改内容

text: Reconnect to change tools for this session.
translated: 请重新连接以更改此会话的工具。

text: Use this optional provider-specific `input_type` value only when the same label should apply to both query and document embedding requests. For asymmetric providers, prefer queryInputType and documentInputType.
translated: 仅当查询和文档嵌入请求应使用相同标签时，才使用此提供商专用的可选 `input_type` 值。对于非对称提供商，请优先使用 queryInputType 和 documentInputType。
命令、钩子、绑定和自动化。

text: This rewrites DREAMS.md and removes only exact duplicate diary entries.
translated: 此操作会重写 DREAMS.md, 仅移除完全重复的日记条目。
可选 · 工作可继续进行

text: Controls post-compaction session memory reindex mode: "off", "async", or "await" (default: "async"). Use "await" for strongest freshness, "async" for lower compaction latency, and "off" only when session-memory sync is handled elsewhere.
translated: 控制压缩后会话记忆的重新索引模式："off"、"async" 或 "await"（默认："async"）。使用 "await" 可最大程度地确保数据最新，使用 "async" 可降低压缩延迟，仅在会话记忆同步由其他机制处理时使用 "off"。

text: Check the portal URL’s DNS, TLS, and network access. For private Tailscale Serve, allow its HTTPS port in your tailnet policy. For a reverse proxy, check the dedicated portal ingress route, then retry.
translated: 请检查门户 URL 的 DNS、TLS 和网络访问情况。如果使用私有 Tailscale Serve，请在 tailnet 策略中允许其 HTTPS 端口。如果使用反向代理，请检查专用的门户入口路由，然后重试。

text: Let agents run commands and use tools on this device.
translated: 允许智能体在此设备上运行命令和使用工具。
要在打开聊天前启用 {name} 吗？

text: Choose a messaging app to set up.
translated: 选择要设置的即时通讯应用。

text: Choose a paired or cloud device before sending another message in this repository session.
translated: 请先选择已配对设备或云端设备，再在此仓库会话中发送下一条消息。

text: Enable log signal export through OpenTelemetry in addition to local logging sinks. Use this when centralized log correlation is required across services and agents.
translated: 除本地日志输出目标外，还启用通过 OpenTelemetry 导出日志信号。需要对跨服务和智能体的日志进行集中关联时，可使用此功能。

text: Per-agent message guard for sending to other conversations on the same provider. Set both this and allowAcrossProviders to false for current-conversation-only public agents.
translated: 针对单个智能体的消息限制设置，用于控制向同一提供商上的其他对话发送消息。对于仅限当前对话的公共智能体，请将此项和 allowAcrossProviders 均设为 false。

text: The conversation context resets. Your dashboard stays.
translated: 对话上下文将重置。 仪表板将保留。

text: This skill changed since you opened it. Your draft is preserved. Copy your changes, then close and reopen the skill to review the current revision before saving.
translated: 此技能在你打开后已发生更改。 你的草稿已保留。 请复制你的更改, 然后关闭并重新打开技能, 查看当前修订版本后再保存。
按提供商设置工具策略

text: Opt-in CIDR/IP allowlist for auto-approving first-time node-role device pairing with no requested scopes. Disabled when unset. Operator, browser, Control UI, and any role, scope, metadata, or public-key upgrade pairing still require manual approval.
translated: 可选启用的 CIDR/IP 允许列表，用于自动批准未请求任何权限范围的节点角色设备的首次配对。未设置时禁用。操作员、浏览器、Control UI，以及涉及任何角色、权限范围、元数据或公钥升级的配对仍需手动批准。
智能体自动化失败告警路由

text: This filename contains terminal control characters, so OpenClaw will not build a copyable shell command for it. Inspect the staged ref directly and enter the path manually with care.
translated: 此文件名包含终端控制字符, 因此 OpenClaw 不会为其生成可复制的 shell 命令。 请直接检查暂存引用, 并谨慎地手动输入路径。

text: The {plugin} plugin owns the memory slot and its config schema has no dreaming section, so these settings cannot be stored. Switch the engine above to edit them.
translated: {plugin} 插件占用了记忆槽位，其配置架构中没有梦境部分，因此无法保存这些设置。请切换上方的引擎以编辑这些设置。

text: Files, commands, web, sessions, and memory.
translated: 文件、命令、网页、会话和记忆。
必须提供 Cron 表达式。
钩子允许的智能体 ID
插件子智能体允许的模型

text: Per-stage exec reviewer timeout in milliseconds for model preparation and completion before falling back to human approval (default: 30000).
translated: exec 审核器在模型准备和生成完成阶段各自的超时时间，单位为毫秒。超时后回退到人工审批（默认值：30000）。

text: Allows callers to supply a session key in hook requests when true, enabling caller-controlled routing. Keep false unless trusted integrators explicitly need custom session threading.
translated: 设为 true 时，允许调用方在钩子请求中提供会话键，从而由调用方控制路由。除非可信集成方明确需要自定义会话归属，否则请保持为 false。

text: Retired tool notes. Local tool conventions now belong in the Tools section of AGENTS.md.
translated: 已弃用的工具笔记。本地工具约定现应放在 AGENTS.md 的 Tools 部分。

text: I've saved my recovery kit somewhere safe
translated: 我已将恢复套件保存在安全的地方

text: Controls which sessions can be targeted by sessions_list/sessions_history/sessions_search/sessions_send/session_status. ("all" default = any session on the Gateway, including other agents and users; "agent" = any session in the current agent id; "self" = only current; "tree" = current session + spawned subagent sessions). Cross-agent access is on by default and scoped by tools.agentToAgent; use narrower visibility to restrict reads and ordinary sends. Explicit agents.entries.<id>.tools.agentToAgent.send destinations can permit sends without widening reads.
translated: 控制 sessions_list/sessions_history/sessions_search/sessions_send/session_status 可访问的会话。（默认值 "all" = Gateway 上的任意会话，包括其他智能体和用户的会话；"agent" = 当前智能体 ID 下的任意会话；"self" = 仅当前会话；"tree" = 当前会话 + 派生的子智能体会话）。跨智能体访问默认开启，范围由 tools.agentToAgent 限定；使用更窄的可见性范围可限制读取和常规发送。显式指定的 agents.entries.<id>.tools.agentToAgent.send 目标可允许发送，而无需扩大读取范围。

text: Choose a delivery mode explicitly, or run openclaw doctor --fix to repair legacy settings.
translated: 请明确选择投递模式，或运行 openclaw doctor --fix 修复旧版设置。

text: This version is too different from today's to compare line by line.
translated: 此版本与当前版本差异过大，无法逐行比较。

text: Provider credential used for API-key based authentication when the provider requires direct key auth. Use secret/env substitution and avoid storing real keys in committed config files.
translated: 提供商要求直接使用密钥进行身份验证时，用于 API 密钥身份验证的提供商凭据。请使用机密值/环境变量替换，避免在提交到版本控制的配置文件中存储真实密钥。

text: The condition has been checked {count} times without matching. Activity history starts when the payload executes.
translated: 已检查条件 {count} 次，均未满足。执行任务内容后才会开始记录活动历史。

text: Decision inspection is bounded to at most 50 records per request.
translated: 决策检查每次请求最多可查看 50 条记录。
上次完成于 {time} · 已归档 {count} 条会话记录

text: Couldn't open that page in the Dashboard
translated: 无法在仪表板中打开该页面

translated: 登录已取消。本次尝试未添加账户。

translated: 由于从 Gateway 读取失败，记录运行状况未知。

text: If set, timeout must be 0 or greater (0 disables this timeout).
translated: 如设置超时时间，其值必须大于或等于 0（0 表示禁用此超时限制）。

text: Optional provider artwork: a local file, public HTTPS image URL, or bundled icon. PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF sources are limited to 2 MiB and 4096 pixels per side and served as a sanitized static PNG. Relative file paths resolve from the active configuration file directory. Invalid artwork falls back to the provider brand or display-name initial.

text: Provider-specific output vector size override for memory embeddings. Gemini models support 128-3072 dimensions and recommend 768, 1536, or 3072; Bedrock families such as Titan V2, Cohere V4, and Nova expose their own allowed sizes. OpenAI-compatible endpoints receive it as `dimensions` and must return vectors of exactly that size. Managed local GGUF embeddings truncate and normalize locally. Expect a full reindex when you change it because stored vector dimensions must stay consistent.
translated: 覆盖记忆嵌入的输出向量维度，具体取值取决于提供商。Gemini 模型支持 128–3072 维，推荐使用 768、1536 或 3072 维；Titan V2、Cohere V4 和 Nova 等 Bedrock 模型系列各自有允许的维度范围。兼容 OpenAI 的端点通过 `dimensions` 接收此值，并且必须返回维度完全一致的向量。托管的本地 GGUF 嵌入会在本地进行截断和归一化。更改此值后需要重建全部索引，因为已存储向量的维度必须保持一致。

translated: 用于存放 OpenClaw 产物的可复用存储位置。核心存储负责位置标识、加密和健康状态；提供程序负责传输对象，使用方决定保留哪些内容。

text: Optional model ceiling for this role's requests and descendants. An empty object allows only the source agent's configured primary and fallback models; omitting the policy leaves model access unchanged. Model aliases resolve before enforcement, and denied models cannot be used by retries or fallbacks. With config reload enabled, changes confined to existing roles' model policies apply when committed without restarting permitted work. Other role changes hot-apply and reconnect clients with current authority.

translated: 更新辅助程序在完成前已停止。请在终端中运行 `openclaw update` 以查看原因。
节点浏览器代理允许的配置文件

translated: 收集器模式的子智能体编排。默认启用；设为 false 可关闭。工具权限仍适用于 agents_wait 和集群生成选项。

text: Another managed update is already running. Wait for it to complete, then refresh update status.
translated: 已有另一项托管更新正在运行。请等待其完成，然后刷新更新状态。

text: Default language hint for audio transcription providers. Set it when the primary spoken language is known and provider detection is unreliable.
translated: 为音频转录服务提供商提供的默认语言提示。当主要口语语言已知且提供商的自动检测不可靠时，请设置此项。
不支持的类型: {type}. 请使用原始模式。

text: Named cloud worker profiles. Each profile selects a worker provider registered by a plugin and carries provider-owned settings.
translated: 具名云端工作节点配置档案。每个配置档案选择一个由插件注册的工作节点提供商，并包含该提供商专用的设置。
智能体 GitHub 配置档案版本

text: Optional paired literal text prefixes for embedding queries and documents, such as { query: "query: ", document: "passage: " }. Replaces automatic model formatting, including for model aliases. Both strings are required; spaces and newlines are preserved, and empty strings select raw text. A non-empty queryInstruction takes precedence for queries. Changing the document prefix requires a reindex.
translated: 可选的成对字面文本前缀，用于查询和文档的嵌入，例如 { query: "query: ", document: "passage: " }。此设置会替代模型的自动格式化，包括使用模型别名时的格式化。两个字符串均为必填项；空格和换行会保留，空字符串表示使用原始文本。对于查询，非空的 queryInstruction 优先。更改文档前缀需要重建索引。

text: Opaque generated profile version used to switch managed credentials atomically.
translated: 自动生成的不透明配置版本标识，用于以原子方式切换托管凭据。

text:
Couldn’t change the model. Try again.

{error}

translated: 请选择现有的云设备配置文件。如果尚未配置，请先添加一个。

text: You need admin access to change automations.
translated: 你需要管理员权限才能更改自动化任务。

text: Browser engine capability preset: "chromium" (default) or experimental "lightpanda" for semantic DOM browsing. Lightpanda requires an explicit ws/wss cdpUrl dedicated to one profile and attachOnly: true, never launches a local browser, and does not support visual screenshots or other Chromium-only features.
translated: 浏览器引擎能力预设："chromium"（默认）或用于语义 DOM 浏览的实验性 "lightpanda"。Lightpanda 要求显式设置专属于一个配置文件的 ws/wss cdpUrl，以及 attachOnly: true。它不会启动本地浏览器，也不支持可视化截图或其他 Chromium 专属功能。

text: Admins can find your profile with openclaw users list --json, then assign a role with users.setRole.
translated: 管理员可以使用 openclaw users list --json 查找你的个人资料，然后使用 users.setRole 分配角色。

text: Couldn’t complete the notification request. Try again.
translated: 无法完成通知请求。请重试。
会话重置归档保留期限

text: Per-agent physical disk budget covering SQLite main/WAL and counted session-directory artifacts (for example `500mb`). Defaults to `10gb`; protected data can keep usage above the target. When exceeded, warn mode reports pressure and enforce mode removes old reset/delete artifacts, unreferenced history, then cap-created archives. Manual, age-retention, dashboard, recovery, and legacy archives remain protected. Set `false`, `0`, or `"0"` to disable.
translated: 每个智能体的物理磁盘预算，涵盖 SQLite 主数据库/WAL 和计入用量的会话目录产物（例如 `500mb`）。默认为 `10gb`；受保护的数据可能使使用量持续高于目标值。超出预算时，warn 模式会报告存储压力，enforce 模式则依次移除旧的重置/删除产物、未被引用的历史记录，以及因条目上限而创建的归档。手动归档、按保留期限归档、仪表盘归档、恢复归档和旧版归档仍受保护。设为 `false`、`0` 或 `"0"` 可禁用。

text: Choose where this credential is stored. Saving changes the reference only; it does not rotate or test the secret.
translated: 选择此凭据的存储位置。保存时仅更改引用，不会轮换或测试机密。

text: Runtime type for this agent: "embedded" (default OpenClaw runtime) or "acp" (ACP harness defaults).
translated: 此智能体的运行时类型："embedded"（默认 OpenClaw 运行时）或 "acp"（ACP 执行框架默认设置）。

text: Couldn’t fork this session. Try again.
translated: 无法创建此会话的分支。请重试。
云端结果已应用, 存在 {count} 处冲突

text: Extra per-profile Chrome DevTools MCP arguments for existing-session attachment, such as --no-usage-statistics. Endpoint arguments here override the built-in auto-connect or browser URL selection.
translated: 为通过 existing-session 连接的各配置文件设置额外的 Chrome DevTools MCP 参数，例如 --no-usage-statistics。此处的端点参数会覆盖内置的自动连接或浏览器 URL 选择。

text: Couldn’t refresh this session. Reload to see the saved permissions.
translated: 无法刷新此会话。请重新加载以查看已保存的权限。

text: Released browser/Gateway-owned WebRTC tries OAuth first and falls back to a Platform API key. Direct backend sockets and unlisted or private routes require Platform API-key access. Delegated work can be steered while running and requires exact spoken confirmation for high-impact actions.
translated: 已发布的浏览器/Gateway 托管 WebRTC 会优先尝试 OAuth，并在失败时回退到 Platform API 密钥。直接后端套接字以及未列出或私有路由需要通过 Platform API 密钥访问。委派的工作可在运行期间调整方向，高影响操作则需要准确的口头确认。

text: Other ways to save your kit are below.
translated: 以下是保存恢复套件的其他方式。

text: A decision receipt proves identity-aware evaluation; it does not by itself mean the action was allowed.
translated: 决策回执证明已进行身份感知评估; 但其本身并不意味着该操作已获允许。

text: No enabled provider currently advertises auto-start setup. Check the provider's setup documentation, enable its plugin, then refresh health. Existing sources remain editable.
translated: 当前没有已启用的提供方声明支持自动启动设置。请查看提供方的设置文档，启用其插件，然后刷新健康状态。现有来源仍可编辑。

translated: 建立上游 TLS 连接时使用的可选 SNI/服务器名称覆盖值。
正在等待 {tools}；无法安全中断。

translated: 显示用于发送快捷消息的悬浮输入框，可通过全局快捷键唤出。

text: Sliding window length in seconds for pair loop budgets. Default for supporting channels is 60.
translated: 用于成对循环配额的滑动窗口长度，单位为秒。支持此功能的渠道默认值为 60。

text: Tell this agent about you and how you like to work. This edits only your personal USER.md, not the shared workspace file.
translated: 向此智能体介绍你自己和你偏好的工作方式。这只会编辑你的个人 USER.md，不会修改共享工作区文件。

text: Allow External Control UI Embed URLs
translated: 允许 Control UI 嵌入外部 URL

text: Maximum number of memory hits returned from search before downstream reranking and prompt injection. Raise for broader recall, or lower for tighter prompts and faster responses.
translated: 在下游重排序和注入提示词之前，搜索返回的记忆匹配项数量上限。调高可扩大召回范围，调低可精简提示词并加快响应。

translated: 添加会话不会将其移出原分组。

text: Enter a whole number of zero or more, or leave ready cloud devices empty.
translated: 请输入大于或等于零的整数，或将就绪云设备数量留空。

translated: 请重新渲染此小组件，以将其导出为图片。

translated: 日期使用 UTC。ID 必须完全匹配。

translated: 可选，设置居中显示的聊天记录的 CSS 宽度，例如 960px、82% 或 min(1280px, 82%)。

text: Connect with a personal profile to save a custom image.
translated: 使用个人资料连接后即可保存自定义图片。

text: Could not copy the claw link. Try again.
translated: 无法复制 claw 链接。请重试。

text: Desktop on the computer running OpenClaw

translated: 以提供商 ID 为键的提供商专属 Talk 设置。迁移期间，优先使用此设置，而非旧版 talk.* 键。

translated: 新建 PostgreSQL 存储模式的前缀（默认值：openclaw）。长度为 1–27 个字符，仅可使用小写字母、数字或下划线，且必须以字母或下划线开头。现有锚点保留其原有模式。

text: Couldn’t open sign-out. Your account is still signed in. Try again.
translated: 无法打开退出登录功能。你的账户仍处于登录状态。请重试。

text: Enables provider batch APIs for embedding jobs when supported (OpenAI/Gemini), improving throughput on larger index runs. Keep this enabled unless debugging provider batch failures or running very small workloads.
translated: 在提供商支持时（OpenAI/Gemini），为嵌入任务启用批处理 API，以提高大规模索引运行时的吞吐量。除非正在调试提供商的批处理故障或运行极小规模的工作负载，否则请保持启用。

text: Continue from where you stopped. Check which actions already completed before retrying anything.
translated: 从中断处继续。在重试任何操作之前，请先检查哪些操作已完成。

text: Outdated or vulnerable dependencies, with upgrade notes.
translated: 查找过时或存在漏洞的依赖，并提供升级说明。

text: Milliseconds of silence before a realtime Talk user turn is committed.
translated: 提交实时 Talk 用户回合前所需的静音时长，以毫秒为单位。

text: Start a fresh transcript session each time humans are present in the source and stop it (generating notes) after the last human leaves. Requires a provider that reports occupancy, such as discord-voice. Default: false (capture continuously from gateway start).
translated: 每次来源中有真人在场时启动新的转录会话，并在最后一位真人离开后停止会话（生成笔记）。需要支持报告人员在场状态的提供商，例如 discord-voice。默认值：false（从 gateway 启动时开始持续采集）。

text: This view is unavailable. Check that its plugin is installed, enabled, and allowed for your account. Reload the conversation after installing or updating the plugin.
translated: 此视图不可用。请检查其插件是否已安装、已启用，并且你的账户有权使用。安装或更新插件后，请重新加载对话。

text: Global agent defaults: skills, tools, and session.
translated: 全局智能体默认设置: 技能、工具和会话。

text: Couldn’t create a new session. Try again.
translated: 无法创建新会话。请重试。

text: Couldn’t load channel settings. Try again.
translated: 无法加载频道设置。请重试。

text: TCP port used by the gateway listener for API, control UI, and channel-facing ingress paths. Use a dedicated port and avoid collisions with reverse proxies or local developer services.
translated: Gateway 监听器用于 API、Control UI 和面向渠道的入站路径的 TCP 端口。请使用专用端口，避免与反向代理或本地开发服务发生冲突。

text: Optional retention window in hours for persisted media handled by the general mtime sweep. Leave unset to disable that sweep, or set values like 24 (1 day) or 168 (7 days) to periodically remove older staged media. Managed outgoing media (chat-generated attachments) is excluded and follows its own SQLite- and transcript-aware retention.
translated: 由通用 mtime 清理机制处理的持久化媒体的可选保留时长，以小时为单位。不设置可禁用该清理机制，也可设置为 24（1 天）或 168（7 天）等值，以定期删除较旧的暂存媒体。受管理的出站媒体（聊天生成的附件）不在此范围内，而是遵循其自身结合 SQLite 和会话记录的保留策略。

text: Accept agent-visible plugin tool descriptors published by paired nodes (default: true). Set false to ignore and remove all node-published plugin tools.
translated: 接受已配对节点发布的、对智能体可见的插件工具描述符（默认值：true）。设为 false 可忽略并移除所有由节点发布的插件工具。

text: Couldn’t check whether Chrome is installed. You can still run setup or refresh status. Make sure the OpenClaw app and CLI are up to date.
translated: 无法检查是否已安装 Chrome。你仍可运行设置或刷新状态。请确保 OpenClaw 应用和 CLI 均为最新版本。
无法加载 {count} 个资源。请重试。

text: Provider channel id for the live transcript source, such as a Discord voice channel or Slack huddle channel. Verify provider-specific id semantics before enabling auto-start.
translated: 实时转录来源在提供方中的频道 ID，例如 Discord 语音频道或 Slack 即时会议频道。启用自动启动前，请确认该提供方对 ID 的具体定义。

text: Marks a managed OAuth profile whose rotating refresh credential is owned by the Gateway. Omitted profiles use a personal access token.
translated: 标记托管的 OAuth 配置，其轮换刷新凭据由 Gateway 持有。未设置此字段的配置使用个人访问令牌。

text: PostgreSQL connection and schema naming. PostgreSQL 16–18 are qualified; other admitted majors remain experimental pending conformance. Back up each store schema together with its local SQLite anchor. See the PostgreSQL operator guide for deployment qualification limits.
translated: PostgreSQL 连接和模式命名。PostgreSQL 16–18 已通过验证；其他允许使用的主版本在通过一致性验证之前仍属实验性支持。请将每个存储模式与其本地 SQLite 锚点一并备份。有关部署验证的限制，请参阅 PostgreSQL 运维指南。

text: Copy cookies from a Chrome-family profile into an isolated managed profile.
translated: 将 Cookie 从 Chrome 系浏览器的配置文件复制到隔离的托管配置文件中。
无输出 — 工具执行已完成。

text: Sign-in stopped because OpenClaw ID could not be verified. Ask the person who manages this claw to check its setup.
translated: 无法验证 OpenClaw ID，登录已停止。请联系此 claw 的管理者检查设置。

text: Couldn’t rename the group. Try again.
translated: 无法重命名分组。请重试。

text: Browse files, artifacts, and changes from this session.
translated: 浏览此会话中的文件、产物和更改。

text: Couldn’t copy the archive path. Try again.
translated: 无法复制归档路径，请重试。

translated: 从系统页面查看并控制此 Mac。默认启用。需要在 macOS 系统设置 → 通用 → 共享中启用屏幕共享。更改会使此 Mac 短暂断开并重新连接；新增功能可能需要配对批准。

translated: video_generate 调用的默认提供商请求超时时间，以毫秒为单位。单次调用的 timeoutMs 会覆盖此值，而此值会覆盖提供商设定的默认值。

text: Removed {removed} duplicate dream entries and kept {kept}.
translated: 已移除 {removed} 条重复的梦境条目并保留 {kept} 条。

translated: 请停止前台运行的 Gateway，运行 `openclaw update`，然后再次启动。如需自动更新，请安装托管的 Gateway 服务。

text: Optional profile-bound operator roles for team Gateways. Each named role controls access to other people's sessions, sandbox isolation, session and run agents, and granted operator scopes; omitting this section preserves existing operator behavior.
translated: 为团队 Gateway 提供的可选操作员角色，与用户配置文件绑定。每个命名角色控制对其他用户会话的访问、沙箱隔离、会话和运行所用的智能体，以及授予的操作员权限范围；省略此部分将保留现有的操作员行为。

text: Provider-specific realtime voice settings keyed by provider id.
translated: 以提供商 ID 为键的提供商专属实时语音设置。

translated: 请使用不含凭据的公共 HTTPS URL，或通过安全路径附加本地文件。

translated: Gateway 正在重试启动采集。请检查提供商配置并刷新健康状态。

text: Default-agent model runtime id: "openclaw", "auto", a registered plugin harness id such as "codex", or a supported CLI backend alias such as "claude-cli".
translated: 默认智能体的模型运行时 ID："openclaw"、"auto"、已注册的插件执行框架 ID（如 "codex"），或受支持的 CLI 后端别名（如 "claude-cli"）。
关闭对话框或退出设置

translated: 此检出副本已处于其跟踪的上游修订版本。
运行已加入队列。运行 ID：{runId}

text: This device can’t reply right now. Wait for it to reconnect, or continue on the Gateway from the last synchronized state.
translated: 此设备目前无法回复。请等待设备重新连接，或在 Gateway 上从上次同步的状态继续。

text: Select a session you can access or change sharing for this session.
translated: 请选择您有权访问的会话，或更改此会话的共享设置。
将 Ask OpenClaw 停靠在右侧

text: Embedded OpenClaw execution contract: "default" keeps the standard runner behavior, while "strict-agentic" enables structured plan tracking and non-visible turn recovery for supported OpenAI/OpenAI Codex GPT-5-family runs.
translated: 嵌入式 OpenClaw 执行契约："default" 保持标准运行器行为，而 "strict-agentic" 为受支持的 OpenAI/OpenAI Codex GPT-5 系列运行启用结构化计划跟踪和用户不可见的轮次恢复。

text: OpenAI declined this request; {model} is not authorized.
translated: OpenAI 拒绝了此请求；{model} 未获授权。

text: Another surface or an earlier attempt recorded the decision first.
translated: 其他界面或先前的尝试已率先记录了审批决定。
已根据保留期限自动归档

text: When true, allow model-provider HTTP requests to private, CGNAT, or similar ranges through the provider HTTP fetch guard (fetchWithSsrFGuard). Custom/local provider base URLs already trust the exact configured origin, except metadata, link-local, and local-use NAT64 (64:ff9b:1::/48) origins; set this to false to opt out of that trust. OpenAI Responses WebSocket reuses request for headers/TLS but does not use that fetch SSRF path. Use true only for operator-controlled self-hosted endpoints that must reach private origins outside the configured baseUrl origin.
translated: 设为 true 时，允许模型提供商向私有、CGNAT 或类似地址范围发起的 HTTP 请求通过提供商 HTTP 获取防护（fetchWithSsrFGuard）。自定义或本地提供商的基础 URL 默认已信任所配置的确切源，但元数据、链路本地和本地使用的 NAT64（64:ff9b:1::/48）源除外；设为 false 可取消此信任。OpenAI Responses WebSocket 复用 request 中的请求头和 TLS 设置，但不使用该获取请求的 SSRF 防护路径。仅当端点由运维人员控制且为自托管，并且必须访问所配置 baseUrl 源之外的私有源时，才应设为 true。
在“个人资料”中管理账号

text: Enter a CSS width such as 960px, 82%, min(1280px, 82%), or calc(100% - 2rem).
translated: 请输入 CSS 宽度，例如 960px、82%、min(1280px, 82%) 或 calc(100% - 2rem)。

text: Opt in to full OpenClaw worker session hosting from Gateway-managed bundles. Disabled by default.
translated: 选择启用基于 Gateway 管理的软件包的完整 OpenClaw 工作进程会话托管。默认禁用。

text: No command owner is set. Ask an admin to set one.
translated: 尚未设置命令所有者。请联系管理员设置。

text: Exact MCP tool names or simple '*' globs to hide from this server.
translated: 要从此服务器隐藏的 MCP 工具的精确名称或简单的 '*' 通配模式。

text: Enter a valid JSON object for subscription arguments.
translated: 请输入有效的 JSON 对象作为订阅参数。
在新标签页中打开活动

text: Sections are full. Remove a section or remove some sessions from sections before adding more.
translated: 分区容量已满。请先移除一个分区，或从分区中移除部分会话，再继续添加。

text: Sign-in saved, but refreshing status failed. Retry
translated: 登录信息已保存，但刷新状态失败。重试
正在上传第 {current} 个，共 {total} 个

text: Milliseconds of audio retained before realtime voice activity is detected.
translated: 在检测到实时语音活动之前保留的音频时长，以毫秒为单位。

text: Goal editing is unavailable. Your draft is unchanged.
translated: 暂时无法编辑目标。你的草稿未更改。

text: This hosted workspace isn’t available. Check its setup or choose another workspace.
translated: 此托管工作区不可用。请检查其设置或选择其他工作区。

text: Couldn’t build the snapshot. Choose an available cloud device that supports project preparation, or check its settings.
translated: 无法构建快照。请选择支持项目准备的可用云设备，或检查其设置。

text: Wait a few minutes, then reconnect with the correct token or password.
translated: 请等待几分钟，然后使用正确的令牌或密码重新连接。

text: Choose which coding apps show their sessions in the sidebar.
translated: 选择要在侧边栏中显示会话的编程应用。

text: Explicit browser executable path when auto-discovery is insufficient for your host environment. Use an absolute stable path, or a path starting with ~ for your OS home directory, so launch behavior stays predictable across restarts.
translated: 当自动发现无法满足主机环境需求时，显式指定浏览器可执行文件的路径。请使用稳定的绝对路径，或以 ~ 开头、指向操作系统用户主目录的路径，以确保重启后的启动行为保持一致。

text: OpenClaw found memory from other coding agents. Import it into your agent’s workspace?
translated: OpenClaw 发现了其他编程智能体的记忆。要将其导入你的智能体工作区吗？

text: Default: 24h; minimum: 1h. Use m, h, or d.
translated: 默认值：24h；最小值：1h。请使用 m、h 或 d。

text: No memory to import yet on this computer.
translated: 此计算机上暂无可导入的记忆。
此操作需要 {scope} 访问权限。

text: Dictation stopped because the Gateway disconnected.
translated: 由于 Gateway 连接断开, 听写已停止。

text: Used for observer digests and other short utility tasks.
translated: 用于生成观察器摘要及执行其他简短的辅助任务。

text: This proposal did not save the change. It did not stop or change the existing watcher.
translated: 此提案未保存更改，也未停止或更改现有监视器。
当前显示 {total} 项中最新的 {returned} 项。

text: This skill has no support files. Scripts, templates, and references appear here.
translated: 此技能没有辅助文件。脚本、模板和参考资料会显示在这里。

text: Images too large to preview here
translated: 图片过大，无法在此预览

text: Controls workspace bootstrap-file injection in the embedded runtime: "always" uses normal injection (default), "continuation-skip" skips eligible continuation turns after a recorded full-bootstrap turn, and "never" disables injection. Does not control CLI-backed prompt preparation.
translated: 控制嵌入式运行时中的工作区引导文件注入："always" 使用常规注入（默认）；"continuation-skip" 在记录了完整引导的轮次之后，跳过符合条件的后续轮次；"never" 禁用注入。此设置不控制基于 CLI 的提示词准备。

text: Couldn’t start this automation. Try again.
translated: 无法启动此自动化任务。请重试。

text: This message is too large to display here.
translated: 此消息过大，无法在此处显示。

text: Couldn’t sign in. Check the MCP server settings and try again.
translated: 无法登录。请检查 MCP 服务器设置后重试。
在此输入你自己的答案

text: Required role applied to authenticated profiles without a valid explicit assignment or matching GitHub login assignment whenever operator roles are configured. Its name must match a configured role definition.
translated: 配置操作员角色时，此角色为必填项，适用于没有有效显式分配或匹配的 GitHub 登录名分配的已认证配置档案。其名称必须与已配置的角色定义匹配。

text: Literal prefix for query embeddings. Used unless a non-empty queryInstruction is set; an empty string disables automatic query formatting.
translated: 用于查询嵌入的字面前缀。除非设置了非空的 queryInstruction，否则使用此前缀；空字符串会禁用查询自动格式化。

text: Skips proxy TLS certificate verification. Use only for controlled development environments.
translated: 跳过代理 TLS 证书验证。仅用于受控的开发环境。

text: Optional process-local Git author and committer name.
translated: 可选的 Git 作者和提交者姓名，仅在当前进程内生效。

text: Enabled by default. This permits capture; it does not start recording a voice channel by itself.
translated: 默认启用。此设置允许记录，但不会自行开始录制语音频道。

text: No cloud devices yet. Start a cloud session to prepare a repository and save a snapshot.
translated: 暂无云设备。启动云端会话以准备仓库并保存快照。

text: Autocorrect is unavailable in browser control. Edit the text directly.
translated: 浏览器控制不支持自动更正。请直接编辑文本。

text: Controls the sqlite-vec semantic index. Keep this advanced override when root and per-agent vector policies differ.
translated: 控制 sqlite-vec 语义索引。当根级向量策略与各智能体的向量策略不同时，请保留此高级覆盖设置。

text: Allow /config chat command to read/write config on disk (default: false).
translated: 允许 /config 聊天命令读写磁盘上的配置（默认值：false）。
自动化 Webhook 允许的主机名

translated: 使用已保存并应用的策略启动一个维护批次。

text: Named export to invoke from the transform module; defaults to module default export when omitted. Set this when one file hosts multiple transform handlers.
translated: 要从转换模块调用的命名导出项；省略时使用模块的默认导出项。当一个文件包含多个转换处理程序时，请设置此项。
线程绑定空闲超时（小时）

text: Enables summary quality audits and regeneration retries for safeguard compaction. Default: true in safeguard mode.
translated: 为 safeguard 压缩启用摘要质量审核和重新生成重试。默认值：在 safeguard 模式下为 true。

text: Per-agent provider-specific tool policy overrides for channel-scoped capability control. Use this when a single agent needs tighter restrictions on one provider than others.
translated: 为单个智能体按提供商覆盖工具策略，以控制渠道范围内的能力。当某个智能体需要对特定提供商施加比其他提供商更严格的限制时，可使用此设置。

Couldn’t guide the agent’s reply. Try again.

无法引导智能体的回复。请重试。

{error}
