translated: 在页面上绘制标记，然后将标注发送到你的会话。

text: Refresh devices to check screen-sharing availability on this computer.
translated: 请刷新设备以检查此计算机是否支持屏幕共享。

text: The agent saves and improves skills as it works, announces each change, and every change can be undone.
translated: 智能体会在工作过程中保存并改进技能，告知每次更改，且每次更改均可撤销。
设备详情已变更，需要批准

text: Update your browser to use OpenClaw
translated: 请更新浏览器以使用 OpenClaw

text: Optional provider-specific `input_type` value for query-time memory embeddings. Use this with OpenAI-compatible asymmetric embedding endpoints that require a query label.
translated: 查询时生成记忆嵌入所用的可选 `input_type` 值，具体取决于提供商。对于需要查询标签且兼容 OpenAI 的非对称嵌入端点，可使用此设置。

text: Describe what OpenClaw should do, then pick when it runs.
translated: 描述 OpenClaw 应执行的操作，然后选择运行时间。

text: Start a background session (in the command palette)
translated: 启动后台会话（在命令面板中）

text: Optional ACP session mode default for this agent (persistent or oneshot).
translated: 此智能体的可选 ACP 会话默认模式（persistent 或 oneshot）。

text: Timestamp of the last successfully committed wizard run.
translated: 上次成功提交的向导运行时间戳。
已完成 {completed} 项，共 {total} 项

text: Explicitly allows this plugin to request api.runtime.llm.complete against a non-default agent id. Keep false unless the plugin is trusted for cross-agent model access.
translated: 显式允许此插件使用非默认智能体 ID 请求 api.runtime.llm.complete。除非信任此插件进行跨智能体模型访问，否则请保持为 false。

text: Counts may be out of date. Retry
Optional meeting URL for providers that join by URL instead of channel id. Use only trusted meeting links because auto-start may join and capture that meeting.
translated: 可选的会议 URL，适用于通过 URL 而非频道 ID 加入会议的提供方。请仅使用可信的会议链接，因为自动启动可能会加入并采集该会议的内容。

text: Your browser didn't open that. Use another option or copy the kit.
translated: 浏览器未能打开该选项。请使用其他选项或复制恢复套件。

text: Complete managed GitHub CLI identity and Git author override for this agent. Omit it to inherit the system identity.
translated: 此智能体的完整托管 GitHub CLI 身份和 Git 作者覆盖设置。省略此项可继承系统身份。

text: More executions could not be loaded. Try again.
translated: 无法加载更多执行记录。请重试。

text: Checking space for the recovery backup
translated: 正在检查恢复备份所需的空间
在 {provider} 上查看所有检查

text: The backend passed to Crabbox, such as AWS, Azure, or Hetzner.
translated: 传递给 Crabbox 的后端，例如 AWS、Azure 或 Hetzner。

text: 50% of measured pings completed in this time or less (median).
translated: 50% 的实测延迟不超过此时间（中位数）。

text: Runs through Claude CLI, using its native login or a selected saved account. An explicitly selected API-key account has separate API billing; CLI doesn’t mean free or subscription-only.
translated: 通过 Claude CLI 运行，使用其原生登录方式或所选的已保存账户。显式选择的 API 密钥账户会单独产生 API 费用；使用 CLI 并不意味着免费或仅按订阅计费。

text: Prefer one capability-tagged tools.media.models entry for audio transcription before the remaining compatible fallbacks.
translated: 优先使用一个带有能力标签的 tools.media.models 条目进行音频转录，然后再尝试其余兼容的备选条目。

text: See the Gateway logs for the exact failure and retry once the cause is fixed.
translated: 请查看 Gateway 日志以了解具体的失败原因，解决问题后重试。

text: Couldn’t load templates from ClawHub. Try again.
translated: 无法从 ClawHub 加载模板。请重试。

text: Open a chat session first so the annotation has somewhere to go.
translated: 请先打开一个聊天会话，以便添加标注。

text: Template for synthesizing structured mapping input into the final message content sent to the target action path. Make the same inputs produce the same message so downstream parsing and behavior remain stable.
translated: 用于将结构化映射输入合成为最终消息内容并发送到目标操作路径的模板。请确保相同的输入生成相同的消息，以使下游解析和行为保持稳定。

text: Create video with supported generation models.
translated: 使用支持的生成模型创建视频。

text: The scheduler is disabled. Enabled automations won’t run.
translated: 调度器已禁用。已启用的自动化任务将不会运行。

text: Refresh-capable auth profile id used to inject the current bearer token into this remote MCP server. When set, OpenClaw resolves and refreshes the profile at runtime and does not project refresh material downstream.
translated: 支持刷新的身份验证配置文件 ID，用于将当前的持有者令牌注入此远程 MCP 服务器。设置后，OpenClaw 会在运行时解析并刷新该配置文件，且不会将刷新所需的凭据传递到下游。

text: BCP 47 locale id for Talk speech recognition on device nodes and the iOS system-voice fallback, for example "ru-RU". Leave unset to use each device default.
translated: 用于设备节点上的 Talk 语音识别及 iOS 系统语音回退的 BCP 47 区域设置标识，例如 "ru-RU"。留空可使用各设备的默认设置。

text: Agent overrides can’t enable tools blocked by the global allowlist:
translated: 智能体的覆盖设置无法启用被全局允许列表阻止的工具：

text: Connect with an API key or token
translated: 使用 API 密钥或令牌连接

text: Discard this local pending copy. This does not cancel a message already received by the Gateway.
translated: 丢弃此本地待处理副本。 这不会取消 Gateway 已收到的消息。

text: Safe case-insensitive regex patterns used to detect explicit mentions/trigger phrases in group chats. Use precise patterns to reduce false positives in high-volume channels; invalid or unsafe nested-repetition patterns are ignored.
translated: 用于检测群聊中明确提及或触发短语的安全正则表达式模式，不区分大小写。在消息量较大的频道中，请使用精确的模式以减少误判；无效或包含不安全嵌套重复的模式将被忽略。

text: Saved accounts removed so far: {count}. Remaining removals did not complete.
translated: 目前已移除的已保存账户数：{count}。其余移除操作未完成。
GitHub 登录名对应的操作员角色

text: Explicit session key override for mapping-delivered messages to control thread continuity. Use stable scoped keys so repeated events correlate without leaking into unrelated conversations.
translated: 为通过映射投递的消息显式覆盖会话键，以控制对话线程的连续性。请使用稳定且作用域明确的键，以便关联重复事件，同时避免将其混入无关对话。
连接已断开。此视图会自动重新连接。

text: It will reconnect with the new token automatically — nothing else to do.
translated: 它将使用新令牌自动重新连接 — 无需其他操作。

text: Labs contains experimental capabilities that may change, break, or disappear between releases.
translated: 实验室包含实验性功能，这些功能可能会在版本更新时发生变化、失效或被移除。

text: Another tab is waiting for browsers to approve. Use that tab, or close it and retry here.
translated: 另一个标签页正在等待浏览器批准。请使用该标签页，或将其关闭后在此重试。

text: Choose the dates to include in every chart and total.
translated: 选择所有图表和总计涵盖的日期范围。

text: Extended stable reports available releases but never installs them automatically.
translated: 扩展稳定版会报告可用版本，但绝不会自动安装。

text: Couldn’t load memory imports. Try again.
translated: 无法加载记忆导入信息。请重试。

text: The private draft could not be opened. It remains in this tab; try Review private draft again.
translated: 无法打开私密草稿。草稿仍保留在此标签页中，请再次尝试“查看私密草稿”。

text: Manage all settings, including the raw config.
translated: 管理所有设置，包括原始配置。
云工作进程就绪储备上限

text: Enable video understanding so clips can be summarized into text for downstream reasoning and responses. Disable when processing video is out of policy or too expensive for your deployment.
translated: 启用视频理解，将视频片段概括为文本，供后续推理和回复使用。如果处理视频不符合政策或对您的部署而言成本过高，请禁用此功能。
请先完成待处理的工作

text: Maximum bytes allowed per daily memory file when building startup context (default: 16384). Files over this boundary-safe read limit are skipped.
translated: 构建启动上下文时，每个每日记忆文件允许的最大字节数（默认值：16384）。超出此安全读取边界限制的文件将被跳过。

text: Compare the verification number on both screens. Approve only a browser you are setting up, and only if the numbers match. Never read the number to anyone.
translated: 请核对两个屏幕上的验证数字。仅批准您正在设置的浏览器，且只有在数字一致时才可批准。切勿向任何人念出该数字。

text: Browse Files to choose “{path}”. This attachment stays open.
translated: 浏览文件以选择“{path}”。此附件将保持打开状态。

text: These sessions have no creator on record, usually because they started before OpenClaw recorded who starts each session.
translated: 这些会话没有创建者记录，通常是因为它们在 OpenClaw 开始记录每个会话的发起者之前就已创建。

text: You need admin access to check Git for this folder. Ask an admin for access.
translated: 你需要管理员权限才能检查此文件夹的 Git 状态。请向管理员申请权限。

text: You can view channels, but only admins can change them.
translated: 您可以查看渠道，但只有管理员可以更改渠道。

text: SKILL.md with supporting files, a folder, or a ZIP (saved on import).
translated: 选择 SKILL.md 及配套文件、文件夹或 ZIP 文件（导入时保存）。
此 Gateway 已保存的登录信息

text: For trusted local admin access, use the shared Gateway token or password.
translated: 如需进行受信任的本地管理员访问，请使用共享的 Gateway 令牌或密码。

text: Milliseconds to keep an OpenClaw-started local model server alive after the last request finishes. Set 0 to keep it alive until OpenClaw exits.
translated: 在最后一个请求完成后，由 OpenClaw 启动的本地模型服务器继续运行的时长（毫秒）。设为 0 可使其持续运行，直到 OpenClaw 退出。

text: Session catalog page did not include the requested host
translated: 会话目录页面未包含请求的主机
自动更新设置和发布渠道

text: Group created, but the move was skipped because the list changed. Move from the row menu.
translated: 分组已创建, 但由于列表已更改, 已跳过移动操作。 请通过行菜单移动。

text: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the local model server readiness check after starting the process.
translated: 启动进程后，等待本地模型服务器通过就绪检查的最长时间，单位为毫秒。

无法加载目标位置。请重试。

text: Run /pair qr again to get a new setup code.
translated: 再次运行 /pair qr 以获取新的设置代码。

text: Global plugin loading, allow and deny lists, and capability slot ownership.
translated: 全局插件加载、允许和拒绝列表，以及能力槽位归属。

text: Plugin UI initialization timed out. Check the plugin and reload its UI.
translated: 插件界面初始化超时。请检查插件并重新加载其界面。
请重新连接以更改插件。

text: Default agent workspace for bootstrap and memory files. Also used as the working directory when agents.defaults.cwd is unset. Set this explicitly when running from wrappers so path resolution stays consistent.
translated: 用于存放引导文件和记忆文件的默认智能体工作区。未设置 agents.defaults.cwd 时，也用作工作目录。通过封装程序运行时，请显式设置此项，以确保路径解析一致。

text: This session can’t continue in a terminal. Check the session and Gateway address.
translated: 此会话无法在终端中继续。请检查会话和 Gateway 地址。

text: Optional account selector for multi-account channel setups when approvals must route through a specific account context. Use this only when the target channel has multiple configured identities.
translated: 用于多账号渠道配置的可选账号选择器，适用于必须通过特定账号上下文路由审批的情况。仅在目标渠道配置了多个身份时使用。
已移除 {removed} 条重复的梦境条目。

text: Now triggers immediately. Next heartbeat waits for the next cycle.
translated: 立即模式会马上触发。 下次心跳模式会等待下一个周期。

text: Add this saved copy to “{chat}” for review? Nothing will be sent.
translated: 要将此已保存的副本添加到“{chat}”以供检查吗？不会发送任何内容。

text: Stop work on any attached devices, then delete the session entries and archive their transcripts.
translated: 停止所有关联设备上的工作，然后删除会话条目并归档其对话记录。

text: Enables Tool Search. When on, OpenClaw hides large tool catalogs behind structured search/describe/call tools during embedded runtime runs.
translated: 启用工具搜索。开启后，OpenClaw 在嵌入式运行时运行期间会隐藏大型工具目录，转而通过结构化搜索、描述和调用工具提供访问。

text: Couldn’t refresh the recap. Try again.
Couldn’t guide the agent’s reply. Try again.
translated: 无法引导智能体的回复。请重试。

text: Restart the Gateway after changing its allowed origins.
translated: 更改允许的来源后，请重启 Gateway。

text: Allow agents to find up-to-date information on the web.
translated: 允许智能体在网上查找最新信息。

text: Cloud session disk space is low
translated: 云端会话磁盘空间不足

text: Enter a class accepted by the selected Crabbox backend and binary. The provider determines its effective sizing.
translated: 输入所选 Crabbox 后端和二进制程序支持的类型。实际资源规格由提供商决定。

text: Rename not applied. The original key was kept. {reason}
translated: 重命名未应用，已保留原键名。{reason}

text: Enable CLI agents and terminals in Gateway settings to start a native CLI.
translated: 请在 Gateway 设置中启用 CLI 智能体和终端，以启动原生 CLI.

text: Ask an admin to grant or restore your access.
translated: 请联系管理员授予或恢复你的访问权限。

text: Default provider request timeout in milliseconds for voice model operations when the caller supports timeouts.
translated: 调用方支持超时时，语音模型操作向提供商发起请求的默认超时时间，以毫秒为单位。

text: Send a message to capture context usage.
translated: 发送消息以记录上下文用量。

text: Selects the registered context engine ID. Plugins with different plugin and engine IDs declare contextEngineIds in their manifest so OpenClaw can load the owner.
translated: 选择已注册的上下文引擎 ID。如果插件 ID 与引擎 ID 不同，插件会在其清单中声明 contextEngineIds，以便 OpenClaw 加载所属插件。

text: Realtime provider speaker voice id override for browser or Gateway-owned Talk sessions.
translated: 覆盖浏览器或 Gateway 管理的 Talk 会话所用的实时提供商说话者音色 ID。

text: Anyone can read without signing in.
translated: 任何人无需登录即可阅读。

text: Narrative entries will appear after the next dreaming cycle.
translated: 下一个梦境周期结束后，将显示叙事条目。

text: Couldn’t read the screenshot. Try again.

translated: 智能体 ACP 工作目录

text: Named MCP server definitions. OpenClaw stores them in its own config and runtime adapters decide which transports are supported at execution time.
translated: 命名的 MCP 服务器定义。OpenClaw 将其存储在自身配置中，由运行时适配器在执行时决定支持哪些传输方式。

text: Optional model override for Gmail-triggered runs when mailbox automations should use dedicated model behavior. Keep unset to inherit agent defaults unless mailbox tasks need specialization.
translated: 为 Gmail 触发的运行设置可选的模型覆盖，适用于邮箱自动化需要专用模型行为的情况。除非邮箱任务需要专门配置，否则请保持未设置，以继承智能体的默认设置。

text: Controls where approval prompts are sent: "session" uses origin chat, "targets" uses configured targets, and "both" sends to both paths. Use "session" as baseline and expand only when operational workflow requires redundancy.
translated: 控制审批提示的发送位置："session" 使用原始聊天，"targets" 使用配置的目标，"both" 则同时发送到两处。建议默认使用 "session"，仅在运维工作流需要冗余通知时扩展发送范围。

text: Logbook is collecting snapshots; cards appear after the first analysis batch completes.
translated: Logbook 正在收集快照；首批分析完成后将显示卡片。

text: Incognito sessions last for 24 hours or until the Gateway restarts. Your unsent input stays in this tab.
translated: 无痕会话持续 24 小时，或在 Gateway 重启时结束。你尚未发送的输入内容会保留在此标签页中。

text: Overrides model-authored source replies for group/channel conversations. Defaults to "automatic" when no global visible reply policy is set. "message_tool" requires message(action=send) for normal assistant output and generic tool media; explicitly host-owned runtime output remains deliverable except for ambient room events. "automatic" posts normal replies as before.
translated: 覆盖群组或频道对话中由模型生成的源回复的发送策略。未设置全局可见回复策略时，默认为 "automatic"。"message_tool" 要求常规助手输出和通用工具媒体通过 message(action=send) 发送；明确归属宿主的运行时输出仍可投递，但环境房间事件除外。"automatic" 按原有方式发布常规回复。

text: This focused view is not supported.

Desktop sharing starts enabled on desktop devices. In the desktop app on that device, check the Desktop sharing switch under Settings. Approve any pending desktop access request here. If sharing still doesn’t work, ask an admin to check the desktop policy. The device needs Screen Sharing or an authenticated local VNC server.
translated: 桌面设备默认启用桌面共享。请在该设备的桌面应用中，检查设置下的桌面共享开关，并在此批准所有待处理的桌面访问请求。如果共享仍无法使用，请联系管理员检查桌面策略。该设备需要启用屏幕共享，或运行经过身份验证的本地 VNC 服务器。

text: Optional HTTP response security headers applied by the gateway process itself. Prefer setting these at your reverse proxy when TLS terminates there.
translated: 由 Gateway 进程自身设置的可选 HTTP 响应安全标头。如果 TLS 在反向代理处终止，建议优先在反向代理中设置这些标头。

text: No devices support command approvals yet.
translated: 目前没有设备支持命令审批。

text: Binary attachment. Its original bytes are preserved when you save.
translated: 二进制附件。 保存时会保留其原始字节。

text: Iframe sandbox policy for hosted Control UI embeds. "strict" disables scripts, "scripts" allows interactive embeds while keeping origin isolation (default), and "trusted" adds `allow-same-origin` for same-site documents that intentionally need stronger privileges.
translated: 托管的 Control UI 嵌入内容的 iframe 沙盒策略。"strict" 禁用脚本，"scripts" 在保持来源隔离的同时允许交互式嵌入内容（默认），"trusted" 则为确实需要更高权限的同站点文档添加 `allow-same-origin`。

text: Use wss:// when the Gateway sits behind HTTPS or Tailscale Serve.
translated: 当 Gateway 位于 HTTPS 或 Tailscale Serve 后方时，请使用 wss://。

text: Couldn’t save the recovery request. Free browser storage and try again. Your goal update wasn’t sent.
translated: 无法保存恢复请求。请释放浏览器存储空间并重试。你的目标更新尚未发送。

text: This session’s device setup was interrupted. Check recent sessions before starting this task again.
translated: 此会话的设备设置已中断。再次启动此任务前，请检查最近的会话。

text: Optional per-agent default thinking level. Overrides agents.defaults.thinkingDefault for this agent when no per-message or session override is set.
translated: 可选的单个智能体默认思考级别。未设置消息级或会话级覆盖值时，此设置将覆盖该智能体的 agents.defaults.thinkingDefault。

text: Couldn’t connect because this page and the Gateway use different versions. Reopen the dashboard.
translated: 无法连接，因为此页面与 Gateway 使用的版本不同。请重新打开仪表盘。

text: Summaries are generated about every 5 minutes when new speech is captured. Follow the Transcript tab for speech as it is saved.
translated: 采集到新的语音时，约每 5 分钟生成一次摘要。请查看“转录”选项卡，跟进已保存的语音内容。

text: Explicit proxy URL used when request.proxy.mode is explicit-proxy. Credentials embedded in the URL are treated as sensitive and redacted from snapshots.
